prompts.title: Sunlit Ivory Lace
prompts.body:
Top: Cream cropped tie-front blouse with a plunging V neckline, thin satin ribbon front bow, ruffled hem, and huge puffed sheer floral-lace sleeves with gathered ruffled cuffs.
Bottom: Light teal-blue washed high-waisted straight-leg jeans with a pointed front and back yoke and classic back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Plain white ribbed ankle socks; cream canvas platform espadrilles with ribbon ankle ties.

prompts.title: Sage Wildflower
prompts.body:
Top: Pastel sage-green cropped milkmaid blouse with a sweetheart neckline, front ribbon lacing, shirred back panel, gathered peplum ruffle hem, and sheer organza puff sleeves embroidered with tiny white wildflowers.
Bottom: Warm cream high-waisted straight-leg denim jeans with a vintage button-fly front, tailored front seams, and high back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Soft cream ribbed ankle socks; sage-green suede Mary Jane flats.

prompts.title: Rose Ribbon Wrap
prompts.body:
Top: Dusty rose-pink cropped wrap blouse with a deep ruffled V neckline, silk ribbon wrap tie below the bust, scalloped eyelet lace hem, and billowy sheer Swiss-dot mesh balloon sleeves with Chantilly lace panels.
Bottom: Faded vintage sky-blue high-waisted jeans with a curved sweetheart yoke on the front and back.
Legwear & Footwear: Plain pale-pink ankle socks; white vintage leather low-top court sneakers.

prompts.title: Buttercup Chiffon
prompts.body:
Top: Soft butter-yellow shirred cropped blouse with a low square ruffled neckline, tiny ivory satin center bow, lettuce-edge ruffled hem, and dramatic puffed sheer floral-jacquard chiffon sleeves with long fitted lace-trimmed cuffs.
Bottom: Classic medium-blue washed high-waisted jeans with front and back square patch pockets and contrast amber stitching.
Legwear & Footwear: Plain ivory pointelle ankle socks; tan leather woven huarache mules.

prompts.title: Cinnamon Cottage
prompts.body:
Top: Structured cinnamon-brown linen underbust corset with cream ribbon front lacing and seamed back panels, layered over an ivory sheer cotton off-shoulder peasant blouse with billowy lantern sleeves and ruffled cuffs.
Bottom: Flowing warm cream tiered cotton skirt with horizontal bands of floral eyelet lace.
Legwear & Footwear: Soft cream pointelle-knit ankle socks; cognac-brown lace-up vintage Victorian ankle boots.

prompts.title: Seventies Terracotta
prompts.body:
Top: Boho terracotta-orange and cream open-knit floral crochet cropped top with a plunging halter neckline tied behind the neck, scalloped crochet hem, and matching detached sheer crochet bell sleeves worn mid-arm.
Bottom: High-waisted rich chocolate-brown ribbed corduroy pants with front and back patch pockets and a braided brown leather belt.
Legwear & Footwear: Warm cream ribbed ankle socks; tan suede 1970s platform clogs with wooden soles.

prompts.title: Seventies Patchwork
prompts.body:
Top: Retro 1970s-inspired mustard-gold and warm cream variegated ribbed-knit cropped polo top with an open V-neck Johnny collar, tiny mother-of-pearl buttons down the bust, and long flared split bell sleeves.
Bottom: High-waisted A-line skirt made of geometric patchwork vintage denim in alternating light, medium, and indigo blue washes with frayed raw-edge seams.
Legwear & Footwear: Plain cream ankle socks with two mustard stripes; retro caramel-brown suede gum-sole skate sneakers.

prompts.title: Sage Velvet Overalls
prompts.body:
Top: Victorian-inspired crisp white broderie anglaise eyelet cotton blouse with a ruffled stand collar, pintuck pleats, and voluminous puffed leg-of-mutton sleeves.
Bottom/Overalls: Tailored sage-green corduroy-velvet wide-leg overall jumpsuit with a cinched corset-seamed waist, antique brass buttons, front bib, and crossing back straps.
Legwear & Footwear: Plain white eyelet-lace ankle socks; vintage brown leather lace-up paddock shoes.

prompts.title: Strawberry Picnic
prompts.body:
Top: Retro strawberry-red and white gingham check cropped blouse with an all-over shirred honeycomb-smocked bodice, keyhole tie neckline with a dainty white bow, white ric-rac trim, and rounded puffed short sleeves with ruffled cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted vintage medium-wash blue denim wide-leg culotte shorts with tailored front pleats, side button tabs, and back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream ribbed crew socks with red picot ruffle trim; cherry-red canvas Mary Jane espadrilles.

prompts.title: Dusty Rose Boho
prompts.body:
Top: Dusty-rose fitted ribbed-knit scoop-neck tank top layered under an open-front ivory cotton-gauze bolero shrug with scalloped floral crochet trim along the open front edges and cropped back hem, and dramatic flared bell sleeves.
Bottom: High-waisted medium-wash vintage blue denim jeans with caramel contrast topstitching, a classic 5-pocket front, a back V-yoke, and ivory crochet-lace appliqué panels stitched onto the two back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Ivory ribbed ankle socks and cognac suede platform clogs with studded wooden soles.

prompts.title: Lilac Boardwalk
prompts.body:
Top: Soft lilac-and-white micro-gingham linen top with an elastic ruffle-trimmed Bardot neckline worn on the outer edges of the shoulders, a fully smocked honeycomb bodice across both the front and back, a short ruffled peplum waist hem, and short puffed sleeves.
Bottom: High-waisted washed-black denim sailor jeans featuring two vertical rows of brushed-silver anchor buttons on the front sailor panel and high-set squared patch pockets on the back.
Legwear & Footwear: White ribbed crew socks with twin lilac stripes and black canvas platform espadrilles with braided jute soles.

prompts.title: Safari Utility
prompts.body:
Top: Olive-green washed linen-cotton safari shirt-jacket featuring a notched camp collar, buttoned shoulder epaulettes, two pleated bellows chest pockets with tortoiseshell buttons, a matching olive fabric tie belt cinching the natural waist, a back storm-flap yoke with a center box pleat, and rolled three-quarter sleeves secured with button tabs.
Bottom: High-waisted warm sand-khaki cotton twill A-line mini skirt reaching mid-thigh, featuring flat utility seams and two side-hip gusseted flap pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Oatmeal ribbed crew socks and tan suede lace-up desert ankle boots.

prompts.title: Autumn Shortalls
prompts.body:
Top: Warm rust-orange crinkle-chiffon peasant blouse featuring a ruffled split V-neckline with untied tassel cords, shirred shoulder yokes, and billowy long lantern sleeves gathered at the wrists.
Bottom: Vintage dark-indigo denim overall shorts (shortalls) reaching mid-thigh with rolled cuffs, gold contrast topstitching, a multi-compartment front bib pocket, antique brass buckle clasps, side hip buttons, and wide denim straps crossing in an X at the back above two patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream waffle-knit crew socks and brown distressed leather work boots.

prompts.title: Buttercup Garden
prompts.body:
Top: Pale buttercup-yellow cotton broderie anglaise blouse featuring a ruffled pie-crust stand collar, floral eyelet cutwork across the bodice and V-shaped ruffle yokes on both front and back, a row of mother-of-pearl buttons down the center back, and puffed elbow-length sleeves with scalloped eyelet cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted sage-green washed linen paperbag-waist shorts reaching mid-thigh, featuring a gathered ruffled top edge, a wide self-tie sage linen bow belt at the front waist, roomy side pockets, and two back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: White pointelle ankle socks with lace trim and tan leather woven ankle-strap espadrille flats.

prompts.title: Prairie Chambray
prompts.body:
Top: Soft dusty-blue lightweight cotton chambray shirt featuring a classic pointed collar, pearlescent snap buttons down the front, two western-style pointed flap pockets on the chest, a curved back yoke with a center box pleat, rolled elbow-length sleeves with button tabs, and long front hem tails tied in a knot at the natural waist.
Bottom: High-waisted terracotta-red quilted cotton A-line mini skirt reaching mid-thigh, patterned all over with tiny cream-and-sage block-printed wildflowers, diamond quilting stitches across the front and back, and two quilted back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream slub-knit crew socks and tan leather clog mules with wooden heels.

prompts.title: Lavender Folk
prompts.body:
Top: Pale lavender washed-linen peasant blouse featuring ivory botanical cross-stitch embroidery framing the wide square neckline in both front and back, voluminous elbow-length raglan puff sleeves with embroidered bands and ruffled cuffs, and an elasticated honeycomb-smocked bodice waist.
Bottom: High-waisted cream fine-wale corduroy shorts reaching mid-thigh, featuring buttoned side-waist tabs, front patch pockets with curved openings, and two rounded back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: White crochet-trimmed cotton ankle socks and tan suede wooden-soled clogs.

prompts.title: Country Sage Gingham
prompts.body:
Top: Crisp ivory cotton lawn peasant blouse featuring wide geometric floral Venice-lace insertions framing the square neckline (in both front and back) and banding the three-quarter puffed sleeves, a pintucked bodice with a drawstring cord bow at the waist, and mother-of-pearl buttons down the center back.
Bottom: High-waisted sage-green and cream check gingham cotton mini skirt reaching mid-thigh, featuring a wide smocked waistband and two softly gathered ruffle tiers edged with ivory picot trim.
Legwear & Footwear: Ivory ruffle-trimmed ankle socks and sage-green canvas Mary Jane espadrilles.

prompts.title: Oatmeal Utility Romper
prompts.body:
Top & Bottom (One-Piece Romper): Tailored oatmeal washed-linen utility romper reaching mid-thigh, featuring an open notched camp collar, structured elbow-length puff sleeves with buttoned cuffs, a wide contoured corset-style waist panel with vertical seaming and two parallel rows of dark coconut-shell buttons down the front torso, a wide elasticated smocked panel across the back waist beneath a pleated back yoke, and tailored shorts with angled front patch pockets and buttoned back flap pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream ribbed cotton crew socks and cognac leather woven fisherman sandals.

prompts.title: Western Suede Fringe
prompts.body:
Top: Fitted forest-green fine merino wool turtleneck sweater with long fitted sleeves, layered underneath a cropped open-front tan buckskin suede Western bolero vest featuring pointed Western chest yokes, whipstitched leather edges, a decorative concho-and-leather tie at the upper chest, and cascading tan suede fringe trimming the pointed back yoke and curved lower hem.
Bottom: High-waisted medium-dark vintage blue denim shorts reaching mid-thigh, featuring stitched turn-up cuffs, copper rivets, a brown leather belt with an engraved antique-brass buckle, and decorative Western scroll stitching on the back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream ribbed boot socks and tan leather Western cowboy boots with tonal stitching.

Top: Cozy oatmeal-cream chunky cable-knit cropped sweater with a wide fold-over Bardot neckline leaving both shoulders and collarbones bare, featuring slouchy balloon sleeves gathered into snug ribbed cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted warm rust-orange bias-cut silk satin slip skirt that skims the hips and thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Thick oatmeal-cream woolen ankle socks; warm chestnut-brown suede ankle booties.

prompts.title: Shearling Trail
prompts.body:
Top: Fitted warm ivory waffle-knit long-sleeve Henley top with a deep unbuttoned lace-trimmed placket, layered under a cropped caramel-tan suede vest lined and trimmed with fluffy cream shearling fleece.
Bottom: High-waisted muted olive-green cotton twill A-line cargo skirt with utility side thigh pockets and a drawstring waist.
Legwear & Footwear: Slouchy cream marled-knit ankle socks; tan suede lace-up shearling-cuffed combat boots.

prompts.title: Cinnamon Equestrian
prompts.body:
Top: Warm honey-oatmeal fisherman-rib knit sweater with a wide boat neckline in front, a dramatic draped low-cowl back held secure by a horizontal knit strap across the shoulder blades, and slouchy lantern sleeves gathered into long fitted ribbed cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted cinnamon-brown supple leather A-line mini skirt reaching mid-thigh, featuring raised vertical paneling seams, a matching leather belt with an oval tortoiseshell buckle at the front waist, and a hidden center-back zipper.
Legwear & Footwear: Oatmeal cable-knit over-the-knee socks and dark brown leather knee-high riding boots.

prompts.title: Cinnamon Campfire
prompts.body:
Top: Cozy cinnamon-rust chunky waffle-knit cropped poncho-sweater featuring a ribbed V-neckline laced through brass grommets with cream braided cotton cord, a relaxed knit hood resting neatly against the upper back, a diagonal cable-ribbed hem reaching the waist, and wide three-quarter cape sleeves layered over fitted cream thermal long sleeves.
Bottom: High-waisted medium-blue vintage denim jeans with golden-tan contrast stitching, copper rivets, front scoop pockets, and classic V-stitched back patch pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Oatmeal marled wool crew socks and tan suede shearling-trimmed moccasin ankle boots.

prompts.title: Highland Hearth
prompts.body:
Top: Heavyweight cream Aran wool cable-knit turtleneck sweater featuring a thick folded ribbed neck, intricate honeycomb, rope, and diamond cable-stitch panels across both the front chest and back, and long full bishop sleeves gathered into deep ribbed wrist cuffs, tucked into the waistband.
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length cinnamon-brown, forest-green, and cream tartan plaid heavy wool maxi skirt, featuring a wide dark-brown leather waist belt with twin antique-brass buckles and deep all-around box pleats.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream fleece-lined thermal tights and dark-brown leather shearling-cuffed lace-up winter boots.

prompts.title: Alpine Loden
prompts.body:
Top: Tailored forest-green boiled-wool Tyrolean jacket trimmed with dark-chocolate loden wool piping along the standing collar, front placket, pocket welts, cuffs, and curved back princess seams, fastened down the front with embossed silver edelweiss coin buttons and finished at the back waist with a two-button martingale half-belt above a center box pleat, layered over a high-necked ivory brushed-cotton blouse with ruffled lace trim peeking at the throat and wrists.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length charcoal-grey heavy wool-flannel wide-leg trousers, featuring double front trouser pleats, angled slash pockets, and two buttoned back welt pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Charcoal merino wool socks and black leather lug-sole winter Chelsea boots.

prompts.title: Burgundy Fair Isle
prompts.body:
Top & Bottom (Long Winter Sweater Dress): Cozy full-length burgundy-wine heavy merino wool sweater dress, featuring a folded ribbed mock neck, a traditional circular Nordic Fair Isle knit yoke in oatmeal, dusty rose, and pine green wrapping continuously around the chest, shoulders, and upper back, a three-button keyhole closure at the back nape, long bishop sleeves with matching Fair Isle patterned cuffs, a braided dark-brown leather belt with an antique-brass buckle cinching the natural waist, and a softly flared vertical cable-knit long skirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Oatmeal wool cable-knit tights and burgundy suede knee-high winter riding boots.

prompts.title: Cashmere Commuter
prompts.body:
Top: Fitted jet-black fine merino wool turtleneck sweater layered underneath a plush camel-tan heavy cashmere wrap coat-cardigan ("coatigan") featuring an oversized ribbed shawl collar that drapes over the shoulders and upper back, long sleeves with wide folded-back ribbed cuffs, patch pockets at the hips, and a wide matching camel knit sash belt tied in a knot at the front waist.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length espresso-brown and cream houndstooth wool-tweed tailored trousers, featuring a straight-wide leg, crisp front center creases, and buttoned back welt pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Black cashmere socks and espresso-brown leather pointed-toe ankle boots.

prompts.title: Shearling Aviator
prompts.body:
Top: Thick oatmeal marled-wool waffle-and-cable fisherman crewneck sweater with long raglan sleeves and ribbed cuffs, layered underneath a structured chocolate-brown distressed-leather aviator vest fully lined with plush cream shearling fleece, featuring an oversized shearling-faced collar with leather buckle straps, exposed cream shearling seams along the front zipper, armholes, waist hem, and T-shaped back yoke, and brass-buckled leather cinch tabs at both side hips.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length dark-indigo wide-wale corduroy trousers, featuring front utility patch pockets, brass rivets, and two back patch pockets beneath a V-shaped yoke.
Legwear & Footwear: Thick cream wool boot socks and tan nubuck shearling-lined winter lace-up boots.

prompts.title: Winter Blue Velvet
prompts.body:
Top: Soft warm white brushed cotton-flannel button-down shirt with a pointed collar and buttoned cuffs, layered underneath a cozy waist-length dusty-blue wool-blend cable-knit cardigan fastened down the front with tortoiseshell buttons, featuring braided cable panels down the front, back, and long lantern sleeves, and two small ribbed patch pockets at the lower front.
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length deep navy-blue heavy cotton-velvet pleated maxi skirt, featuring a wide flat velvet waistband with twin tortoiseshell buttons at the back waist and lush, heavy vertical folds.
Legwear & Footwear: Navy-blue thermal fleece tights and cognac leather brogue lace-up ankle boots.

prompts.title: Folklore Tapestry
prompts.body:
Top & Bottom (Layered Long Folk/Winter Dress): Warm cream brushed-cotton high-neck poet blouse with a pintucked chest yoke, ruffled stand collar, and long full bishop sleeves with buttoned ruffled cuffs, worn underneath a full-length winter dress featuring a fitted rust-orange cotton-velvet bodice laced across the front chest with forest-green velvet ribbon through antique-brass hooks, diamond-stitched back seams framing the spine, and an attached heavy woven floral-tapestry jacquard maxi skirt in warm rust, olive-green, and antique-gold tones gathered into a wide pleated waistband.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream wool ribbed tights and dark-brown leather lace-up Victorian mid-calf boots.

prompts.title: Heather & Tweed
prompts.body:
Top: Soft, fluffy heather-plum brushed mohair-and-wool turtleneck sweater featuring a tall cozy folded neck, diagonal chevron-ribbed knit texture across the front and back panels, saddle-shoulder seams, and long full sleeves gathered into tall ribbed wrist cuffs, neatly tucked into the skirt waist.
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length oatmeal-and-taupe herringbone wool-tweed maxi skirt, featuring a matching tweed waist belt with a tortoiseshell buckle, a deep front inverted pleat, slanted side handwarmer pockets, and two buttoned welt pockets on the back.
Legwear & Footwear: Heather-grey thermal wool tights and deep-plum leather block-heel winter boots.

prompts.title: Admiralty Coatdress
prompts.body:
Top & Bottom (Layered Long Winter Coat-Dress): Fitted cream-and-navy horizontal-striped fine merino wool turtleneck sweater with long sleeves extending slightly past the outer cuffs, worn underneath a tailored full-length navy-blue heavy melton-wool coat dress, featuring wide notched lapels, two vertical columns of antique-gold anchor buttons down the double-breasted bodice, long tailored wool sleeves with gold-buttoned cuff tabs, a two-button martingale half-belt across the pleated back waist, and a structured A-line long wool skirt with buttoned flap pockets at the hips.
Legwear & Footwear: Opaque navy-blue thermal tights and black leather knee-high equestrian winter boots.

prompts.title: Sage Quilted Velvet
prompts.body:
Top: Soft cream pure cashmere ribbed turtleneck sweater layered underneath a warm hip-length sage-green diamond-quilted silk-velvet jacket featuring chocolate-brown satin piping along the standing Mandarin collar, center front placket, cuffs, and curved back seams, fastened down the front with five knotted chocolate-brown silk frog closures and flaring slightly into a pleated back peplum at the waist.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length espresso-brown heavy wool-crepe wide-leg trousers, featuring crisp double front pleats, slanted side pockets, and two back welt pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream cashmere crew socks and dark-brown suede block-heel winter Chelsea boots.

prompts.title: Cozy Toggle Walk
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Plush cream shearling winter earmuffs with a knit-wrapped headband arched over the crown behind the front hairline, paired with a thick berry-red hand-knitted wool cable scarf wrapped twice around the neck with two fringed ends hanging down the front chest.
Top: Heavyweight camel-tan melton-wool duffel coat featuring a shoulder storm cape yoke, an attached wool hood resting neatly down the upper back, wooden toggle closures on twisted hemp rope loops down the front, and large patch pockets, layered over a chunky oatmeal Aran cable-knit wool sweater whose thick ribbed cuffs peek out at the wrists.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length dark chocolate-brown wide-wale corduroy winter trousers.
Legwear & Footwear: Thick cream Nordic wool boot socks and dark-brown shearling-lined leather snow boots.

prompts.title: Evergreen Cape Coat
prompts.body:
Neckwear: Oversized cinnamon-rust, pine-green, and cream brushed cashmere tartan blanket scarf wrapped thickly around the neck and shoulders with one fringed end hanging down the right front chest and the other tossed over the left shoulder to drape down the back.
Top: Tailored forest-green heavy Austrian loden-wool winter coat featuring a buttoned overshoulder capelet, horn buttons down the front placket, a matching loden-wool belt buckled at the waist, and long tailored coat sleeves layered over a chunky cream ribbed fisherman turtleneck sweater whose folded collar and thick ribbed cuffs peek out warmly.
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length charcoal-grey heavy wool-flannel pleated maxi skirt emerging beneath the coat hem.
Legwear & Footwear: Charcoal fleece-lined thermal tights and black leather shearling-lined tall winter boots.

prompts.title: Harbor Peacoat
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Plush cream shearling earmuffs with a stitched chocolate-brown suede headband over the top of the head, paired with a super-chunky oatmeal-cream seed-stitch wool infinity snood scarf looped doubly around the neck and resting over the coat collar.
Top: Heavyweight burgundy-wine double-breasted boiled-wool peacoat featuring wide notched lapels, two vertical rows of antique-brass anchor buttons, handwarmer welt pockets, and a buttoned martingale half-belt across the back waist, worn slightly open at the upper chest to reveal a cream, burgundy, and pine-green Nordic Fair Isle wool sweater underneath (with matching Fair Isle sweater cuffs peeking out at the wrists).
Bottom: High-waisted full-length deep navy-blue heavy wool-twill winter trousers.
Legwear & Footwear: Oatmeal merino wool socks and chocolate-brown leather lace-up winter boots.

prompts.title: Blush & Dove Grey
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Cozy dusty-rose-pink braided cable-knit winter earmuffs trimmed with fluffy white shearling puffs over the ears, paired with a matching thick dusty-rose-pink cable-knit wool scarf knotted in a warm loop at the throat with two fringed ends resting down the front chest.
Top & Bottom Layers: Plush dove-grey double-faced merino-and-cashmere belted wrap coat featuring wide shawl lapels, deep patch pockets, a center back seam, and a matching dove-grey wool sash belt tied in a bow-knot at the waist, layered over a full-length ivory-cream chunky cable-knit wool maxi sweater dress whose ribbed turtleneck collar, long cable-knit cuffs, and vertical cable-knit skirt panel remain warmly visible.
Legwear & Footwear: Ivory fleece-lined thermal tights and taupe suede shearling-cuffed winter ankle boots.

prompts.title: Pine & Shearling
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Warm tan suede and plush cream shearling winter earmuffs worn over the ears, paired with a thick pine-green fisherman-ribbed merino wool scarf wrapped snugly around the neck with two ends hanging down the front chest.
Top: Heavyweight hip-length espresso-brown sheepskin leather B-3 aviator jacket fully lined in thick cream shearling fleece, featuring an oversized cream shearling collar, exposed cream shearling seams along the front, back yoke, and waist hem, wide turned-back cream shearling wrist cuffs, and buckled brown leather cinch straps at the side hips, worn partially zipped over a thick cream waffle-knit wool sweater (cuffs peeking at the wrists).
Bottom: High-waisted full-length oatmeal-and-brown flecked Donegal wool-tweed winter trousers.
Legwear & Footwear: Thick pine-green wool socks and espresso-brown leather lug-sole winter hiking boots.

prompts.title: Snowy Day Parka
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Fluffy cream wool-bouclé winter earmuffs with a cognac-brown leather headband across the crown, paired with a thick brushed wool plaid scarf in mustard-gold, navy-blue, and cream wrapped snugly around the throat.
Top: Warm navy-blue wool-blend winter parka coat lined in plush cream sherpa fleece, featuring a sherpa-lined hood resting across the upper back, brass snap-and-toggle front storm placket, a drawstring waist with leather cord locks, and buttoned flap pockets, layered over a heather-grey chunky cable-knit wool cardigan and a cream thermal turtleneck (both visible at the upper chest and extending slightly at the wrists).
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length cognac-brown wide-wale corduroy A-line maxi skirt with a center front seam emerging beneath the parka hem.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream thermal fleece tights and cognac leather shearling-lined duck boots.

prompts.title: Houndstooth Greatcoat
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Plush heather-grey cashmere and faux-fur winter earmuffs over the ears, paired with a voluminous brushed plum-berry mohair scarf with twisted fringe wrapped warmly around the neck (one fringed end hanging down the front left chest, the other draped over the right shoulder down the back).
Top: Tailored charcoal-and-ivory houndstooth heavy wool double-breasted winter greatcoat featuring wide peaked lapels, two columns of black horn buttons, structured shoulders, buttoned cuff tabs, and a two-button martingale half-belt across the back waist, layered over a thick cream cable-knit cashmere turtleneck sweater whose folded neck and ribbed cuffs peek out warmly.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length jet-black heavy winter cotton-velvet wide-leg trousers.
Legwear & Footwear: Black cashmere thermal socks and black leather block-heel winter boots.

prompts.title: Countryside Quilted
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Plush cinnamon-brown faux-fur winter earmuffs with a braided dark-brown leather headband over the crown, paired with a super-chunky cream Aran cable-knit wool scarf knotted warmly at the front of the throat with thick fringed ends resting down the chest.
Top: Warm olive-green diamond-quilted wool-flannel winter coat trimmed with dark-brown corduroy piping along the collar, front placket, cuffs, pocket flaps, and back waist belt, fastened with antique-brass snap buttons and worn slightly open at the top to show a warm rust-orange and cream Nordic Fair Isle wool sweater underneath (with matching Fair Isle sweater cuffs peeking out at the wrists).
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length dark forest-green and navy Black Watch tartan heavy wool pleated maxi skirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Dark-green thermal merino wool tights and dark-brown leather lace-up winter brogue boots.

prompts.title: Nordic Lodge
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Fluffy white shearling winter earmuffs with a black velvet headband across the crown, paired with a thick red-and-black buffalo-check brushed wool scarf wrapped snugly around the neck with two fringed ends resting down the front chest.
Top: Heavyweight hip-length charcoal-grey boiled-wool Nordic cardigan-coat featuring a plush shawl collar, ornate embossed pewter Norwegian hook-and-clasp closures down the center front, and woven folk-pattern jacquard tape trim in crimson, white, and silver along the front placket, pocket welts, cuffs, and back waist seam, layered over a thick cream ribbed thermal wool sweater whose cuffs peek out at the wrists.
Bottom: High-waisted full-length medium-grey heavy wool-flannel pleated winter trousers.
Legwear & Footwear: Charcoal merino wool socks and black leather shearling-lined winter boots.

prompts.title: Winter Cream Trench
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Cozy caramel-brown suede and cream shearling winter earmuffs worn over the ears, paired with a voluminous sage-green chunky brioche-ribbed wool scarf wrapped around the neck with one long end hanging down the front chest and the other draped over the shoulder down the center back.
Top: Heavyweight warm cream boiled-wool double-breasted winter trench coat featuring notched lapels, storm flaps on the front chest and upper back, tortoiseshell buttons, buckled wrist straps, and a tied cream wool waist belt, layered over a rich cocoa-brown cable-knit wool turtleneck sweater whose folded turtleneck collar and thick cable-knit cuffs peek out warmly.
Bottom: High-waisted ankle-length dark chocolate-brown heavy pleated wool-crepe maxi skirt emerging beneath the coat hem.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream fleece-lined thermal tights and chocolate-brown suede tall winter riding boots.

prompts.title: Yacht Club Classic

prompts.title: Sunbaked Crochet

Top: Cream silk blouse with a narrow ruffled collar and soft maroon neck tie, worn beneath a fitted olive velvet waistcoat with fine brass piping and small decorative buttons.
Bottom: Mustard-gold A-line midi skirt in textured jacquard, with discreet side pockets and a deep box pleat at the back.
Legwear & Footwear: Cocoa ribbed knee socks and dark brown leather lace-up ankle boots with a modest heel.
Accessories: Small brass floral brooch and a narrow leather belt with a simple antique-gold buckle.

prompts.title: Peacock Street Polish
prompts.body:
Top: Deep-teal fine-ribbed square-neck top with short fitted sleeves and a smooth, close fit.
Bottom: High-waisted dark-indigo straight-leg jeans with a clean drape and subtle peacock-blue satin piping along the outer seams.
Layer: Cropped peacock-green satin bomber with a clean zip front, understated ribbed collar and cuffs, and a soft sheen rather than decorative embroidery.
Footwear: Black leather platform loafers with a slim, modern sole.
Accessories: Small peacock-enamel hoop earrings and a compact black shoulder bag with a silver chain strap.

prompts.title: Amber Country Walk
prompts.body:
Outerwear: Amber waxed-cotton field coat with a softly structured collar, storm flap, large patch pockets, and a removable belt.
Top: Ochre cashmere turtleneck with fine ribbed cuffs.
Bottom: Chocolate-brown wool wide-leg trousers with front pleats and a clean drape.
Footwear: Dark brown leather riding boots with a low heel.
Accessories: Amber glass earrings, cognac leather gloves, and a compact dark-olive shoulder bag.

Bottom: High-waisted tartan wool mini skirt in muted forest green, navy, and antique gold plaid reaching mid-thigh, featuring a flat wrap-front apron panel fastened with two dark brown leather side buckles at the left hip and crisp knife pleats across the back.

Bottom: High-waisted matte black raw-silk tailored shorts reaching mid-thigh, featuring a clean bandless waist with a hidden side zipper, flat front, and sleek welt pockets on the back.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer black floral-lace stockings and black velvet Mary Jane block heels.

Bottom: High-waisted warm camel-tan brushed suede A-line mini skirt reaching mid-thigh, featuring a vertical row of dark tortoiseshell buttons down the center front, angled front patch pockets, and a Western-style pointed back yoke.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer dark-brown nylon tights and camel suede block-heel knee-high boots.

prompts.title: Sculpted Plum
prompts.body:
Top: Rich plum-purple heavy silk charmeuse blouse featuring a folded asymmetric cowl collar fastened at the left collarbone with two antique-pewter buttons, an overlapping tulip-draped back panel that leaves a subtle triangular keyhole opening at the lower back above the waistband, and full bishop sleeves with tall pewter-buttoned gauntlet cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted warm mid-grey wool-flannel tailored shorts reaching mid-thigh, featuring wide turned-up cuffs, front knife pleats, a narrow plum leather belt with a silver buckle threaded through belt loops, and two buttoned back welt pockets.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer charcoal-grey tights and plum suede ankle-strap block-heel pumps.

prompts.title: Parisian Blush
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Soft rose-pink wool beret worn tilted far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow ivory silk ribbon tied in a neat bow around her neck.
Top: Tailored rose-pink and cream woven bouclé tweed cropped jacket with frayed fringe trim along the collarless neckline, front opening, and four front patch pockets, worn open over a glossy ivory silk charmeuse scoop-neck camisole tucked into the waist.
Bottom: Matching high-waisted rose-pink and cream bouclé tweed A-line mini skirt with a fringed lower hem resting at the upper thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer ivory ankle socks with lace trim and blush-pink patent-leather block-heel Mary Janes.

prompts.title: Bubblegum Boulevard
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Padded bubblegum-pink velvet headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, with the high folded collar of her pale-blush ribbed turtleneck framing her neck.
Top: Fine-gauge pale-blush-pink merino wool ribbed turtleneck sweater tucked neatly into her jeans, layered underneath a glamorous, ultra-fluffy bubblegum-pink plush faux-fur cropped coat worn open with wide notched lapels and voluminous full-length sleeves.
Bottom: High-waisted fitted light-wash blue denim jeans with rose-pink contrast stitching and a bubblegum-pink suede belt with a fabric-covered buckle at the waist.
Legwear & Footwear: Pale-pink cashmere socks and bubblegum-pink pointed-toe suede ankle boots.

prompts.title: Y2K Berry Crush
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Baby-pink cotton twill baseball cap worn backwards on her head with the strap behind her bare forehead and the curved brim pointing straight back, leaving her neck bare.
Top: Fitted baby-pink ribbed cotton scoop-neck cropped baby tee exposing a toned bare midriff, layered underneath a plush berry-pink velour cropped zip-up track hoodie worn fully unzipped with its attached velour hood resting down behind her shoulders and ribbed velour cuffs.
Bottom: Matching low-rise berry-pink plush velour flare track pants with a wide ribbed waistband and a tied berry-pink satin drawstring bow at the front waist, fitted through the hips and thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: White no-show socks and chunky white-and-pink platform dad sneakers.

prompts.title: Rosewood Muse
prompts.body:
Neckwear: Narrow rosewood silk-satin choker ribbon tied around her neck with long trailing ribbon ends down her back.
Top: Cozy, fuzzy strawberry-milk-pink brushed-mohair knit sweater featuring a wide folded off-the-shoulder bardot neckline that exposes her bare collarbones and upper shoulders, relaxed long balloon sleeves with ribbed cuffs, and a French-tucked waistline.
Bottom: High-waisted glossy rosewood-pink liquid silk-satin bias-cut midi skirt that drapes smoothly over her hips and thighs, creating a rich texture contrast against the fuzzy mohair knit.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and blush-pink strappy kitten-heel mules.

prompts.title: Flamingo Boardroom
prompts.body:
Top: Structured blush-pink matte-satin strapless sweetheart corset bustier top with vertical boning seams, worn underneath a sharp, tailored flamingo-pink crepe double-breasted blazer left unbuttoned with peaked lapels, lightly padded shoulders, fabric-covered pink buttons, and sleeves pushed neatly up to the mid-forearms.
Bottom: High-waisted peony-pink tailored wide-leg suit trousers with crisp front knife pleats and side slash pockets, worn with a matching peony-pink fabric waist belt.
Legwear & Footwear: Hot-pink pointed-toe satin stiletto pumps.

prompts.title: Rosewater Riviera
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Wide woven blush-pink raffia headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, with the dusty-rose linen halter ties fastened in a soft bow at the nape of her neck.
Top: Fitted dusty-rose linen wrap-front halter crop top featuring a sweetheart plunge neckline and a tied waist sash, worn with an airy, translucent blush-pink silk-organza cropped bolero shrug with billowy puff sleeves draped lightly over her shoulders and arms, leaving a narrow strip of bare midriff visible.
Bottom: High-waisted cream-and-rose-pink tonal floral jacquard tailored mini shorts with cuffed hems resting at the upper thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and dusty-rose braided leather espadrille wedge sandals.

prompts.title: Candy Rebel
prompts.body:
Neckwear: Narrow candy-pink faux-leather choker band around her neck (pure strap, no metal charms).
Top: Fitted white cotton pointelle-knit scoop-neck cropped tank top, layered underneath an edgy-sweet glossy candy-pink patent faux-leather cropped moto jacket worn open with notched lapels, shoulder epaulets, and zippered cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted pastel-pink knife-pleated flared tennis mini skirt resting at the upper thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: White slouchy crew socks and candy-pink platform Mary Jane loafers.

prompts.title: Uptown Peony
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Wide pleated rose-pink silk-satin headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck and collarbones bare.
Top: Plush peony-pink cashmere cable-knit cropped cardigan fastened only at the top button below the V-neckline with a matte pink knit button, parting open in an inverted V below the chest to reveal the cowl-neck bodice of a glossy rose-pink silk charmeuse slip dress underneath.
Bottom: Bias-cut skirt portion of the rose-pink silk charmeuse slip dress skimming smoothly over her waist, hips, and upper thighs down to a delicate scalloped rose-pink lace hem at mid-thigh.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and blush-pink suede kitten-heel slingbacks.

prompts.title: Mauve Coffee Run
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Ribbed mauve-pink knit beanie worn pushed far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a cozy cream sherpa fleece collar on her jacket.
Top: Fitted blush-pink waffle-knit long-sleeve henley top with an unbuttoned V-placket at the chest, worn tucked underneath an open mauve-pink wide-wale corduroy cropped trucker jacket lined with fluffy cream sherpa fleece along the collar and front placket.
Bottom: Matching high-waisted dusty-pink wide-wale corduroy carpenter pants with front patch pockets and a relaxed straight-leg fit.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream wool crew socks and dusty-pink suede lug-sole chelsea boots.

prompts.title: Magenta Starlet
prompts.body:
Neckwear: Narrow magenta-pink velvet ribbon tied neatly around her neck.
Top: Glamorous fitted blush-pink fine-ribbed boat-neck long-sleeve top featuring wispy, fluttering blush-pink marabou and ostrich feather trim ringing both wrist cuffs, tucked cleanly into her trousers.
Bottom: Sleek high-waisted vibrant magenta-pink tailored satin-crepe cigarette trousers with a wide tailored waistband and pressed front creases hugging her hips and thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Blush-pink feather-trimmed satin mules.

prompts.title: Yuletide Ermine Mantle

Legwear & Footwear: Thick cream knitted wool-silk winter hose and crimson velvet fur-lined court slippers.

Bottom: Deeply pleated midnight-blue and silver damask skirt falling in heavy, warm folds from the high empire waist over her hips and thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Pale-grey wool hose and midnight-blue velvet ankle boots lined with silver-fox fur.

Legwear & Footwear: Cream wool stockings and dark-brown leather medieval winter court boots trimmed with sable fur.

Legwear & Footwear: Ivory cable-knit wool hose and frost-blue suede fur-trimmed court shoes.
