prompts.body: clothes: asymmetrical russet leather wrap dress with a fur shoulder mantle, layered utility belt, amber brooch, reinforced bracers, thigh-high strapped boots

prompts.title: Lunar Valkyrie Envoy
prompts.body:
Top: Sculpted pearl-grey leather and moon-silver filigree breastplate bodice over a sheer mist-silk high-neck underblouse, with articulated silver wing-feather pauldrons and long split sleeves fastened by glowing moonstone studs.
Bottom: Asymmetric high-fantasy court tunic and sweeping dove-grey silk-chiffon split overskirt etched with luminous silver runes, worn over fitted slate suede riding leggings.
Layer: Floor-sweeping pale-silver velvet mantle anchored to the shoulder armor with crescent-blade clasps, trailing like liquid moonlight.
Footwear: Knee-high dove-grey leather boots with sculpted silver wing guards at the ankles.
Accessories: Winged silver-and-moonstone Valkyrie diadem, rune-engraved belt with a suspended crystal reliquary, and armored silver finger rings.

prompts.title: Lothlorien Canopy High Elf
prompts.body:
Top: Molded celadon-and-moss elven cuirass bodice crafted from overlapping metallic silver-leaf plates and emerald silk, with living-look silver vine straps curving over bare shoulders into sheer cascading leaf sleeves.
Bottom: Divided elven court riding skirt of iridescent silver-green silk and layered translucent fern-cut organza panels that part over fitted sage-suede trousers.
Layer: Ethereal floor-length mantle of gossamer silver-leaf lace and glowing dewdrop beadwork, clasped at the throat with an emerald elven star.
Footwear: Tall silver-grey suede elven boots wrapped in embossed metallic vine greaves.
Accessories: Pointed silver-branch circlet framing elven-style ear cuffs, glowing green peridot drop necklace, and a leaf-forged girdle.

prompts.title: Obsidian Starfall Archon
prompts.body:
Top: Boned obsidian velvet and blackened-silver filigree bodice with a dramatic floating star-crest collar, inset with glowing crimson star-rubies and sheer midnight-illusion sleeves dripping with silver meteor-chain fringe.
Bottom: Extra-long cathedral-train gown skirt of angular wine-red velvet and midnight-blue astral silk panels that part like folding wings over a shimmering silver-constellation underskirt.
Layer: Architectural high-shouldered astral cape in deep crimson and void-black silk, stiffened into starry geometric points and fastened with a levitating-style ruby astrolabe clasp.
Footwear: Pointed obsidian court heels with silver star-spur ankle cuffs.
Accessories: Spiked silver-and-ruby starfall crown, celestial chain throatpiece, and rune-ringed hand chains.

prompts.title: Tempest Dragon-Scale Warden
prompts.body:
Top: Iridescent storm-blue dragon-scale breastplate bodice forged with crackling silver lightning filigree and winged spaulders, worn over a high-collared abyssal-teal silk tunic.
Bottom: Fitted charcoal leather combat-court breeches beneath a sweeping split battle-skirt of overlapping slate dragon-hide tassets and flowing storm-cloud chiffon.
Layer: Dramatic windswept mantle of silver-threaded tempest silk fastened with twin roaring storm-drake clasps.
Footwear: Armored dark-slate boots with articulated silver dragon-claw greaves.
Accessories: Silver storm-crest circlet, gauntlets etched with lightning runes, and a glowing blue topaz talisman belt.

prompts.title: Amethyst Sanctum Chronomancer
prompts.body:
Top: Sculpted midnight-violet velvet and antique-silver arcane bodice framed by a levitating-style collar of interlocked silver clockwork halos and raw amethyst shards, with cathedral-length bell sleeves lined in glowing violet rune-silk.
Bottom: Sweeping split mage-court skirt of layered dark-plum brocade and translucent lavender mist-organza, revealing an underdress woven with luminous silver sigils.
Layer: Translucent twilight-violet astral veil draping from crystalline shoulder spires into a long shimmering train.
Footwear: Pointed amethyst velvet heels caged in silver arcane scrollwork.
Accessories: Floating-look amethyst crystal spire crown, silver hourglass-and-rune belt chains, and spell-inscribed ring bracelets.

prompts.title: Bloodthorn Briar Sorceress
prompts.body:
Top: Sculpted crimson-and-obsidian bodice formed like overlapping rose petals, caged in bronze-gold metal briar vines set with glowing ruby shards, with sheer wine-red illusion sleeves trailing into pointed petal cuffs.
Bottom: Dramatic high-fantasy gown skirt made of tiered burgundy silk-velvet petals and translucent crimson tulle that unfurls like a giant dark blossom, parted over an ember-gold underskirt etched with luminous rune-thread thorns.
Layer: High arched collar of sculpted bronze thorns and velvet petals framing the neck, with a floating sheer garnet mantle that drifts from ruby shoulder clasps.
Footwear: Pointed dark-crimson heels wrapped in sculpted gold vine-work around the ankles.
Accessories: Crown of intertwined gold thorns and crystalline blood-roses, a levitating-style ruby spire pendant at the throat, and clawed filigree finger rings.

prompts.title: Moonlit Sylvan Archmage
prompts.body:
Top: Sculpted celadon-and-silver cuirass bodice forged like interlocking willow leaves set with glowing moonstones, worn over a sheer mist-silk underblouse with trailing split illusion sleeves edged in luminescent silver fern filigree.
Bottom: Sweeping high-fantasy court skirt of layered mist-grey silk chiffon and emerald velvet tassets that part over a glowing silver-rune underskirt, pooling into a long enchanted forest train.
Layer: Floating-look silver-tissue shoulder mantle woven with glowing moonflower sigils and suspended from arched silver antler pauldrons.
Footwear: Tall pearl-grey suede arcane boots wrapped in sculpted silver fern-and-vine greaves.
Accessories: Branching silver antler-and-moonstone crown, cascading crystal drop ear-cuffs, and an arcane reliquary waist chain.

prompts.title: White-Tree Luminary Priestess
prompts.body:
Top: Sculpted pearl-ivory silk and silver-filigree corset bodice patterned like intertwined sacred tree roots, worn over a sheer moon-lace underblouse with dramatic cathedral-length angel sleeves that trail luminous silver leaf-vein embroidery.
Bottom: Extra-long ceremonial court skirt of dove-grey silk and layered ivory organza tabard panels edged in glowing moonstone beadwork and silver filigree lace.
Layer: High-collared translucent pearl-tissue mantle suspended from sculpted silver branch shoulder-pieces that arch like sacred boughs.
Footwear: White suede fantasy court boots wrapped in silver vine-work and pearl clasps.
Accessories: Radiant silver-branch and moonstone halo crown, cascading pearl-chain ear cuffs, and a glowing reliquary girdle.

prompts.title: Solaris Dawn Archon
prompts.body:
Top: Structured royal-sapphire velvet and burnished-gold armor-corset embossed with a blazing sun-crest, layered over a sheer ivory organza blouse with billowing lantern sleeves caught by sculpted gold sun-ray cuffs.
Bottom: Dramatic high-fantasy court skirt with pointed sapphire-and-gold brocade overskirt wings parting over a floor-pooling ivory silk underskirt woven with luminous golden solar runes.
Layer: Architectural high-collared sapphire mantle framed by gilded sun-ray spikes along the shoulders and fastened with a glowing sunstone core.
Footwear: Gilded court heels with sculpted solar-wing ankle guards.
Accessories: Spiked gold sunburst halo crown, levitating-style sunstone prism earrings, and an astral chain waist belt.

prompts.title: Opaline Starlight Fey Princess
prompts.body:
Top: Iridescent blush-pearl and lilac corset bodice sculpted like overlapping crystal petals, laced with glowing star-spun gold cord and framed by floating puff sleeves of sheer opaline organza dusted with tiny suspended crystals.
Bottom: Asymmetric layered fairy-court gown with cascading handkerchief petals of butter-gold, pastel lilac, and rose-opaline silk-tulle that shimmer like aurora light and trail into an ethereal cloud-like train.
Layer: Gossamer constellation veil-cape attached to winged crystal shoulder brooches, drifting behind in a pastel starlight gradient.
Footwear: Pearl-gold heeled slippers entwined with crystal-studded vine straps.
Accessories: Floating-style crystal star crown, pearl-and-prism shoulder chains, and a crescent-moon throatlet.

prompts.title: Solar Phoenix Pyromancer
prompts.body:
Top: Sculpted molten-gold and amber dragon-scale corset bodice with a flared phoenix-crest neckline, inlaid with glowing sunstone shards and gilded feather pauldrons that arch above the shoulders.
Bottom: Dramatic high-low mermaid-cut court skirt fitted through the hips in overlap-plated marigold silk and opening into an extra-long cascading train of translucent flame-orange, ember-red, and gold-leaf organza tail-feathers that glow along the edges.
Layer: Split wing-like cape of sheer iridescent fire-silk anchored to the shoulder armor with sculpted talon clasps, trailing behind like living embers.
Footwear: Gilded talon-strapped high heels set with faceted fire opals.
Accessories: Radiant phoenix-plume halo crown, coiled gold flame armlets, and rune-etched sunstone hand chains.

prompts.title: Midnight Dragon-Scale Cuirass
prompts.body: clothes: cropped dark-blue dragon-scale cuirass with sculptural hip plates over midnight balloon trousers, separate floor-length cape, gold embroidery, black horned floral headpiece, blue tassel earrings, armored knee boots

prompts.title: Astral Nebula Astromancer
prompts.body:
Top: Iridescent rose-quartz and midnight-indigo boned bodice framed by a floating celestial astrolabe collar in silver filigree, with sheer illusion sleeves woven with glowing silver star-threads and suspended crystal droplets.
Bottom: Sweeping cathedral-length fantasy gown with a sculpted petal-tiered overskirt in rose-violet silk that parts over a deep cosmos-blue underskirt illuminated by woven silver constellations and drifting nebula-like tulle layers.
Layer: Translucent starlight-veil mantle attached to crescent-moon shoulder brooches, pooling on the floor in a shimmering gradient from blush rose to twilight sapphire.
Footwear: Pointed celestial-silver court heels with winged ankle guards and moonstone stars.
Accessories: Multi-ringed silver armillary halo crown, floating-style crystal prism earrings, and a chained astral girdle.

prompts.title: Storm Court Sovereign
prompts.body: clothes: deep indigo court robe with gold embroidered lightning tracery, detached floating sleeves suspended at the shoulder, high-slit skirt over narrow trousers, wide brocade sash, jeweled circlet, lacquered court sandals

prompts.title: Sylvan Dryad Sovereign
prompts.body:
Top: Corset bodice sculpted from living-look antique gold bark filigree and deep emerald velvet, cradled by curving gilded branch pauldrons sprouting translucent crystal leaves and dewdrops.
Bottom: Grand bell-shaped puff ballgown skirt of layered moss-green velvet, gilded fern lace, and glowing champagne-organza petals, gathered into dramatic botanical swags with an elongated forest-floor train.
Layer: Monumental translucent cicada-and-leaf wing mantle in iridescent ivory and celadon organza, veined with raised gold metallic thread and spreading from the upper back like enchanted canopy wings.
Footwear: Emerald velvet court heels wrapped in sculpted gold root-and-vine ankle cages.
Accessories: Branching golden antler-and-blossom crown, glowing amber-drop earrings, and vine-scroll finger armor.

prompts.title: Ivory Constellation Petals
prompts.body: clothes: ivory off-shoulder celestial gown with a fitted illusion bodice, detached draped sleeves and a gold-edged overskirt split into long petal panels and sweeping tails over a full midnight-blue starfield underskirt, gold floral back ornament, celestial choker, star earrings, constellation waist chains, pointed-cuff gloves, trailing gold hairpiece

prompts.title: Blush Butterfly Side Train
prompts.body: clothes: blush-pink off-shoulder butterfly gown with a fitted corset bodice, broad organza flutter-ruffle sleeves and an oversized translucent butterfly at one shoulder, softly draped column skirt with diagonal hip pleats and a sheer asymmetrical side train, floral-vine embroidery, crystal butterflies, sheer embroidered opera gloves, butterfly choker, hairpins and earrings

prompts.title: Periwinkle Ribbon Constellations
prompts.body: clothes: periwinkle and silver-lilac gown with a sculpted sweetheart corset, cape-draped shoulders and sheer cold-shoulder bishop sleeves, overlapping leaf-shaped waist panels and a crystal-flower centerpiece, weightless ombre A-line skirt with transparent overskirt ribbons curling around the train, floral constellations, crystal crown, layered necklace, star earrings, arm drapes, hand chain, floral heels

prompts.title: Sapphire Star Slit
prompts.body: clothes: midnight-blue celestial gown with an off-shoulder plunging corset, sharply pointed basque waist and long translucent sapphire cape sleeves, fitted hips wrapped in asymmetrical folds, fluid gradient skirt with a jeweled thigh slit and semi-sheer starfield train, crescent forehead ornament, crystal face chains, constellation necklace, star earrings, arm chains, hand jewelry

prompts.title: Twilight Morpho Archfey
prompts.body:
Top: Iridescent violet-and-obsidian corset bodice molded like overlapping butterfly wings, framed by a luminous silver-filigree collar and off-shoulder sheer illusion sleeves that flare into scalloped morpho-wing cuffs dusted with glowing amethyst pollen.
Bottom: Cathedral-length high-fantasy court gown with layered royal-purple velvet and translucent lilac-indigo organza overskirts shaped into four sweeping butterfly-wing panels that part over a starry silver-threaded underskirt.
Layer: Ethereal stained-glass wing capelet of sheer twilight-violet and cyan-iridescent organza veined in sterling silver, anchored to crystal-set thorax brooches at the shoulders.
Footwear: Pointed violet satin court heels wrapped in silver filigree antennae straps and tiny fluttering crystal wings at the heels.
Accessories: Crown of silver filigree branches and hovering-look crystal butterflies, luminescent violet throat pendant, and articulated silver wing-vine hand chains.

prompts.title: Pearl Celestial Jumpsuit
prompts.body: clothes: pearl-white one-legged draped celestial jumpsuit with a modest fitted bodice, pale-blue star embroidery, floating sleeve panels, layered star necklace, silver slippers

prompts.title: Orchid Petal Tailcoat
prompts.body: clothes: short structured dark-blue petal bodice over wide opaque midnight palazzo trousers, long split back train, pale-blue orchid appliques, star brooch, gold-trimmed shoes

prompts.title: Violet Ribbon Dance Tunic
prompts.body: clothes: asymmetric white-and-violet dance tunic with gold trim over fitted opaque leggings, pale-blue sash, floating shoulder panels, golden collar necklace, ribbon-wrapped violet boots

prompts.title: Golden Star Herald
prompts.body: clothes: warm yellow lace-up bodice over an ivory blouse with detached puff sleeves, white tailored shorts beneath a long constellation-print tailcoat, star-shaped belt clasp, gold boots, blue gem earrings

prompts.title: Celestial High-Low
prompts.body: clothes: white high-neck dress with a flowing high-low skirt and midnight-blue starfield lining, frilled sleeves, white choker, crystal star hairpins, silver knee boots

prompts.title: Celestial Archmage
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Wide-brimmed pointed midnight-indigo velvet archmage hat embroidered with gold-thread star maps worn tilted far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a high standing indigo velvet astral collar lined in gold silk that frames her bare neck.
Top: Sculpted midnight-indigo silk-velvet mage bodice richly embroidered with shimmering gold-and-silver thread zodiac constellations and celestial astrolabes across the bust and waist, paired with billowy, translucent twilight-blue silk-organza bishop sleeves scattered with embroidered silver stars and gathered into deep gold-embroidered velvet gauntlets at the wrists.
Bottom: High-waisted midnight-indigo velvet open-front archmage overskirt bordered with woven gold arcane runes, parting at the center front over a pleated champagne-gold liquid silk-satin underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer midnight-blue silk stockings and indigo velvet pointed mage heels embroidered with gold crescent moons.

prompts.title: Celadon Sylvan Envoy
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Braided celadon-green and gold silk-vine woodland circlet headband adorned with fabric white star-blossoms worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck and collarbones bare.
Top: Molded forest-emerald sueded-velvet bodice crafted from overlapping leaf-shaped panels contoured to her bust and waist and veined with delicate gold-thread botanical embroidery, paired with cascading, gossamer celadon-green silk-chiffon angel sleeves shaped like translucent willow leaves that flutter open from the shoulders.
Bottom: High-waisted layered petal skirt of moss-green and celadon-green silk-organza over a fitted golden-champagne silk underskirt, tied around the waist with a braided gold silk-vine sash.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs wrapped in ribbon-like celadon silk-satin vine sandals.

prompts.title: Obsidian Wyvern
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Sculpted obsidian-black and crimson silk horned-crest court headpiece worn pushed far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow crimson silk-velvet choker band around her neck.
Top: Form-fitting obsidian-black dragon-scale embossed matte leather corset bodice featuring a plunging sweetheart neckline and raised gold-thread embroidery of two twin wyverns coiling up her torso, worn over a molten-crimson silk-satin under-bodice with structured, layered dragon-wing crimson silk shoulder pauldrons and fitted black-and-crimson slashed sleeves.
Bottom: Dramatic pleated molten-crimson silk-duchesse court skirt parted beneath the pointed black dragon-scale corset waist to reveal a charcoal-and-gold brocade underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Black silk hose and obsidian dragon-scale embossed leatherheeled court boots.

prompts.title: Sun-Spire Phoenix
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Stiffened gold-brocade solar-ray court coronet headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, with a high phoenix-feather collar framing the back of her neck while leaving her throat bare.
Top: Sculpted radiant saffron-gold silk-satin corset bodice embroidered with rising phoenix plumage in copper, scarlet, and gold silk threads, topped with a dramatic shoulder capelet of layered crimson, tangerine, and gold rooster-and-pheasant feathers and trailing flame-shaped ombré silk-chiffon sleeves.
Bottom: High-waisted finely pleated silk-plissé court skirt transitioning in a fiery ombré gradient from bright saffron-gold at the waist to deep tangerine and ruby-crimson at mid-thigh, cinched with a braided gold silk cord.
Legwear & Footwear: Shimmering gold-thread sheer stockings and crimson satin court heels with gold flame embroidery.

prompts.title: Twilight Fae Illusionist
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Delicate black-velvet and iridescent-organza lunar-moth wing headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow black velvet ribbon tied in a bow around her neck.
Top: Iridescent amethyst-purple and peacock-teal shot-silk taffeta sweetheart bodice that shifts color in the light, laced up the center front with black velvet ribbon over a sheer lavender silk chemise, and fitted with ethereal, translucent pleated silk-organza sleeves printed and embroidered with luminous teal-and-violet luna-moth wing veins.
Bottom: Draped, asymmetrical twilight-violet and teal shot-silk overskirt gathered up at the hips into scalloped wing-like folds over a sheer layered lavender tulle and satin underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer lavender silk stockings and amethyst velvet lace-up fae court slippers.

prompts.title: Thalassian Sea Ambassador
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Sculpted iridescent mother-of-pearl satin and coral-pink fabric sea-fan headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck and shoulders completely bare.
Top: Strapless, fan-pleated mother-of-pearl iridescent silk-satin scallop-shell bustier bodice richly embroidered with silver and coral-pink silk sea-branches along the underbust, paired with off-the-shoulder, flowing seafoam-aqua translucent silk-chiffon wave drapes that wrap lightly around her upper arms.
Bottom: High-waisted, liquid-draped seafoam-aqua and pearl-white ombré micro-pleated silk-chiffon court skirt with a sculpted, shimmering mother-of-pearl satin wave-crest peplum resting over her hips.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and pearl-white satin ankle-wrap court sandals.

prompts.title: Glass Mountain Rose
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Delicate wreath of silver-dusted blush-pink silk winter roses and frosted white fabric leaves worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck and collarbones bare.
Top: Off-the-shoulder frosted blush-pink crushed-velvet sweetheart corset bodice embroidered with silver-thread ice crystals and adorned along the portrait neckline with three-dimensional blush-and-silver silk roses, paired with cascading, crystal-pleated ice-grey translucent silk-organza sleeves that flutter like frozen waterfalls.
Bottom: High-waisted, voluminous ice-grey and blush-pink shot-silk taffeta fairytale court skirt that shimmers like spun glass over her hips and thighs, caught up at the sides with frosted blush silk rosettes.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer pale-pink silk stockings and silver-and-blush embroidered satin court pumps.

prompts.title: Silver Birch Dryad
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Woven silver-white silk-branch and pale-mint fabric mistletoe circlet worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck bare.
Top: Sculpted dove-grey and metallic-silver birch-bark textured jacquard corset bodice with a deep sweetheart neckline and white silk-cord front lacing, paired with gossamer, translucent white Chantilly frost-lace bell sleeves that drape delicately from her upper arms.
Bottom: High-waisted pale lichen-mint silk-chiffon fairytale skirt overlaid with laser-cut white velvet birch-leaf panels arranged like overlapping winter foliage around her hips and upper thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs wrapped in crisscrossing white silk-velvet ribbon ballet-style court slippers.

prompts.title: Shadow-Weaver Duchess
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Pointed obsidian-black velvet court hood resting loosely down behind her shoulders (leaving her head and forehead bare), paired with a dramatic, boned black-and-wine velvet batwing standing collar rising behind her neck and a narrow wine-red satin ribbon around her throat.
Top: Hourglass-boned deep wine-burgundy silk-velvet corset bodice overlaid with intricate obsidian-black cobweb Chantilly lace, featuring a plunging sweetheart neckline and sheer black tulle flared bell sleeves embroidered with silver-thread spiderwebs and gothic filigree.
Bottom: High-waisted wine-burgundy velvet court skirt draped with swags of black cobweb lace caught up at the hips with black satin fabric roses.
Legwear & Footwear: Black cobweb-lace stockings and wine-burgundy velvet pointed court heels.

prompts.title: Blood-Rose Enchantress
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Crown-like wreath of three-dimensional dark-crimson velvet roses and black silk leaves worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow black velvet ribbon tied around her neck.
Top: Off-the-shoulder scarlet silk-satin and jet-black velvet sweetheart corset bodice embroidered with climbing black-silk briar thorns up the ribs and bust, trimmed along the portrait neckline with blooming three-dimensional crimson silk-velvet roses, and finished with dramatic, floor-sweeping black-to-scarlet ombré silk-chiffon mage sleeves.
Bottom: Voluminous scarlet silk-satin court skirt pleated into a deep pointed Basque waist and overlaid with a sheer black tulle overskirt embroidered with trailing thorny rose vines.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer black stockings embroidered with a climbing rose-vine seam and scarlet velvet court pumps.

prompts.title: Rosebud Rendezvous
prompts.body:
Top: Blush-pink silk bodice with square neckline, appliquéd 3D rosebuds in cream and coral, and puffed organza sleeves tied with green ribbon at the elbow.
Bottom: Wide tiered skirt of pink, peach, and sage-green tulle, embroidered with trailing ivy and tiny pearl dewdrops, with a flowing petal-shaped train.
Accessories: Crown of woven twigs and fresh-looking silk blossoms, pearl drop earrings, and a thin gold chain bracelet with a ladybug charm.
Footwear: Soft cream slippers with embroidered vines and small satin bows.

prompts.title: Blushing Royalty
prompts.body:
Top: Blush satin bodice with a sweetheart neckline, rosegold thread filigree, and sheer ivory puff sleeves edged in pearl beading.
Bottom: Grand dome ballgown in layered pink tulle over a hooped skirt, with cascading 3D silk roses, scalloped lace trim, and a long petal-edged train.
Accessories: Pearl-and-rosegold tiara, drop pearl earrings, and a cameo locket on a satin ribbon.
Footwear: Blush satin slippers with pearl-beaded toes and ribbon ankle ties.

prompts.title: Once Upon a Sapphire
prompts.body:
Top: Royal blue velvet bodice with a square neckline, gold braid trim, and puffed sleeves slashed with cream satin.
Bottom: Full A-line skirt in sapphire silk with a cream front panel embroidered in gold vines and tiny stars, finished with a sweeping cape-train.
Accessories: Gold crown set with sapphires, sapphire teardrop earrings, and a thin gold chain with a tiny key charm.
Footwear: Cream satin flats with gold embroidery and small blue gem buckles.

prompts.title: Wisteria Wishes
prompts.body:
Top: Lavender satin off-the-shoulder bodice with silver beadwork, sheer lilac organza sleeves, and a ruffled sweetheart neckline.
Bottom: Giant dome skirt in layered lilac and pearl tulle, scattered with embroidered wisteria blossoms and crystal dewdrops, with ruffled tiers cascading to the hem.
Accessories: Silver tiara with amethyst blooms, long crystal earrings, and a delicate wisteria-spray hairpiece.
Footwear: Pale lilac silk slippers with silver bows and crystal accents.

prompts.title: Wildwood Whimsy
prompts.body:
Top: Sage-green velvet bodice with a sweetheart neckline, gold leaf embroidery, and sheer ivory sleeves tied with moss-green ribbons.
Bottom: Wide fairytale skirt in layered green and cream tulle, with hand-appliquéd ivy, tiny silk blossoms, and a trailing train patterned with woodland vines.
Accessories: Crown of gilded branches with pearl buds, acorn-shaped earrings, and a dewdrop pendant on a fine gold chain.
Footwear: Cream satin slippers with embroidered vines and small green ribbon bows.

prompts.title: Peachy Waltz
prompts.body:
Top: Peach satin bodice with a sweetheart neckline, ivory lace trim, and puffed organza sleeves tied with cream ribbon bows.
Bottom: Full ballgown skirt in layered peach and champagne tulle, with embroidered tiny rosebuds and a soft ruffled hem.
Accessories: Pearl hair combs, small gold drop earrings, and a satin choker with a pearl charm.
Footwear: Cream satin slippers with pearl buttons and ribbon ankle ties.

prompts.title: Minty Minuet
prompts.body:
Top: Pale mint silk bodice with a square neckline, silver thread vine embroidery, and sheer white sleeves gathered with tiny pearl bands.
Bottom: Wide tiered skirt in mint and ivory chiffon, edged with scalloped lace and scattered with silk daisies.
Accessories: Silver headband with small crystal flowers, dangling pearl earrings, and a thin silver bracelet with a heart charm.
Footwear: Soft white slippers with mint bows and silver stitching.

prompts.title: Berry Bonbon
prompts.body:
Top: Raspberry velvet bodice with a heart neckline, cream satin piping, and short puffed sleeves with lace cuffs.
Bottom: Poofy ballgown skirt in layered berry-pink and white tulle, with ruffled tiers, sugar-pearl beading, and a satin sash tied in a big back bow.
Accessories: Mini pink-crystal tiara, ribbon hair bow, and candy-pink gem earrings.
Footwear: Pink satin Mary Janes with white ribbon bows.

prompts.title: Lemon Drop Soirée
prompts.body:
Top: Buttery yellow satin bodice with an off-the-shoulder neckline, gold-thread floral embroidery, and sheer ivory ruffle sleeves.
Bottom: Bright layered skirt in lemon, cream, and soft gold organza, with sparkling sequin accents and a flowing ribbon-edged hem.
Accessories: Gold tiara with citrine petals, pearl-drop earrings, and a tiny gold sunburst pendant.
Footwear: Gold satin slippers with cream ribbon ties and small crystal accents.

prompts.title: Lavender Twirl
prompts.body:
Top: Soft lavender silk bodice with a V-neckline, silver embroidery along the seams, and sheer lilac sleeves with ruffled edges.
Bottom: Swirling circle skirt in layered lavender and pearl-gray chiffon, with embroidered violets, silver beadwork, and a gently trailing back panel.
Accessories: Silver circlet with amethyst blossoms, long crystal earrings, and a ribbon necklace with a tiny moon charm.
Footwear: Pale lilac slippers with silver bows and delicate beading.

prompts.title: Cherry Cotillion
prompts.body:
Top: Cherry-red velvet bodice with a sweetheart neckline, cream lace collar, and sheer white puff sleeves with satin bow cuffs.
Bottom: Floor-sweeping skirt in layered crimson silk and ivory tulle, with embroidered cherry blossoms, a ruffled lace hem, and a long flowing train.
Accessories: Pearl-and-ruby hair clips, small gold hoop earrings, and a velvet ribbon choker with a cherry charm.
Footwear: Red satin slippers with gold buckles and ribbon ankle ties.

prompts.title: Sky Serenade
prompts.body:
Top: Powder-blue satin bodice with a boat neckline, silver cloud embroidery, and sheer white organza sleeves with ruffled edges.
Bottom: Extra-long ballgown skirt in layered sky-blue chiffon and silver-white tulle, with hand-stitched swirling wind motifs, tiny crystal raindrops, and a sweeping cathedral-length train.
Accessories: Silver tiara with pale sapphire accents, drop crystal earrings, and a feather-shaped pendant on a thin chain.
Footwear: Pale blue silk slippers with silver bows and crystal beading.

prompts.title: Plum Pirouette
prompts.body:
Top: Plum velvet bodice with an off-the-shoulder neckline, silver beaded trim, and sheer lilac sleeves with gathered cuffs.
Bottom: Sweeping skirt in deep plum satin layered with lavender tulle, with silver grape-vine embroidery, tiny pearl clusters, and a long gently rippling train.
Accessories: Silver comb with amethyst blooms, long pearl-and-crystal earrings, and a ribbon necklace with a small plum-blossom charm.
Footwear: Dusty-plum satin slippers with silver ribbon ties and pearl accents.

prompts.title: Snowdrop Sonata
prompts.body:
Top: Ivory satin bodice with a sweetheart neckline, frosted seed-pearl embroidery, and sheer white tulle sleeves dusted with crystal beads.
Bottom: Dramatic floor-length skirt in layered white organza and pale-silver tulle, with embroidered snowdrops, a scalloped lace hem, and a long shimmering train.
Accessories: Crystal tiara shaped like snowdrop blossoms, pearl drop earrings, and a delicate silver locket on a ribbon.
Footwear: White satin slippers with silver bows and tiny crystal accents.

prompts.title: Raven Court Knight
prompts.body: clothes: blackened articulated plate cuirass over a fitted burgundy gambeson and narrow leather trousers, feather-etched pauldrons, raven brooch, steel gauntlets, armored boots

prompts.title: Emerald Elven Prince
prompts.body: clothes: emerald velvet high-collar tunic with leaf-shaped brocade panels over silver-grey fitted trousers, short chiffon shoulder cape, moonstone circlet, engraved belt, silver vambraces, pale riding boots

prompts.title: Desert Spellblade
prompts.body: clothes: sand linen wrap tunic beneath a bronze scale-leather cuirass, loose rust trousers wrapped at the calf, turquoise sash, etched bracers, indigo head wrap, amulet pouch, strapped desert boots

prompts.title: Crimson Tower Mage
prompts.body: clothes: crimson wool robe-coat with a rigid black standing collar over a fitted damask tunic and straight trousers, gold constellation embroidery, crystal staff brooch, spellbook satchel, pointed boots

prompts.title: Orchid Cloud Knight
prompts.body: clothes: pale-lilac sculpted leather breastplate with orchid etching over a white quilted arming coat, slim grey trousers, short chiffon shoulder mantle, opal clasp, silver gauntlets, engraved sword belt, pale leather boots

prompts.title: Glass Orchard Alchemist
prompts.body: clothes: smoke-grey sleeveless leather doublet fitted with vial loops over a moss high-neck shirt, plum wool breeches, glass fruit charms, brass eye-loupe on a chain, specimen satchel, crystal finger guards, green buckle boots

prompts.title: Ember Stag Warden
prompts.body: clothes: rust boiled-leather chest harness beneath a sweeping blackened-wool antler mantle, fitted ochre jerkin, heavy riding trousers, carved stag torque, ember-glass bracers, fur map pouch, armored boots

prompts.title: Cloud Harp Oracle
prompts.body: clothes: white pleated tunic with a structured gold chest band and wide open sleeves, sky-grey draped trousers, harp-string collar chain, cloudstone circlet, gold arm torque, gold-laced sandals

prompts.title: Sunlit Tunic Wanderer
prompts.body: clothes: short loose snow-white tunic with wide open sleeves belted by tooled brown leather, thin gold chain draped across the chest, gold cuffs at the wrists, woven arm bands, brown leather sandals laced to the calf

prompts.title: Jade River Traveler
prompts.body: clothes: blue-green cross-front robe with a wide brown sash and folded cuffs, moss green loose trousers gathered at the ankle, rope-strung shoulder bag, jade ring at the belt, pale blue cloth shoes

prompts.title: Twilight Comet Tailcoat
prompts.body: clothes: midnight-purple velvet tailcoat with a gradient chiffon comet train at the back, silver fitted mock-neck, wide black trousers, crystal shoulder chains, star ear cuff, pointed shoes

prompts.title: Wayfarer Vision Kimono
prompts.body: clothes: pale celestial-blue short kimono jacket with floating detached sleeves and fine silver embroidery, fitted grey under-layer, dark tapered trousers, short star-patterned cape at one shoulder, glowing pendant stone, knee-high traveler boots

prompts.title: Aurora Glass Diviner
prompts.body: clothes: smoked-glass diviner coat with faceted lens plates at the lapels over a charcoal high-neck shirt, straight slate trousers, orrery pendant, brass-rimmed monocle on a chain, star-chart cuff wrap, dark leather ankle boots

sections.name: Northern Realms & Winter Court
sections.description: Layered fantasy regalia, winter ceremony and cold-weather roles from northern courts and realms.
sections.descriptionRu: Многослойные фэнтезийные наряды, зимние церемонии и образы обитателей северных дворов и королевств.

prompts.title: Winter Court Regent
prompts.body: clothes: ice-blue brocade gown with a white fur-trimmed mantle, silver filigree gorget, detachable bell sleeves, aquamarine earrings, crystal belt clasp, pale boots

prompts.title: Aurora Antler Sovereign
prompts.body: clothes: full-length midnight wool-silk gown with lined long sleeves, fitted silver-embroidered bodice, petal pleats, and quilted underskirt, detachable blue-fur mantle with clasp, crystal diadem, moonstone ear chains, velvet gloves, and shearling-lined ice-blue boots.

prompts.title: Frostflower Thorn Duchess
prompts.body: clothes: pearl-grey wool faille coatdress with lined sleeves, thorn-embroidered nipped bodice, scalloped hem, and quilted charcoal underskirt, removable charcoal-fur pelisse, frosted rose reliquary, waist chain, pearl ear cuffs, ivory gloves, and insulated pointed snow boots.

prompts.title: Moonwolf Vowkeeper
prompts.body: clothes: slate velvet gown with lined long sleeves, fitted silver scale corslet, moon-wolf embroidery at the cuffs, and layered wool underskirt, detachable grey wolf-fur cloak, moon-opal circlet, oath locket, braided gloves, and fur-lined white riding boots.

prompts.title: Glasslake Fae Regent
prompts.body: clothes: glacier-blue cashmere gown with lined sleeves, tailored white brocade bodice, ice-lily beadwork at the neckline, and pleated wool underskirt, removable silver-fox mantle, pearl shoulder chains, crystal perfume cage, wool gloves, and insulated blue snow boots.

prompts.title: Snowmoth Bride
prompts.body: clothes: milk-white quilted silk gown with lined cocoon sleeves, silver moth embroidery, fitted waist, and tiered wool underskirt, detachable hooded cape edged in grey fur, moonstone chatelaine, fur muff, and shearling-lined ivory boots.

prompts.title: Pine-Crowned Rival Heir
prompts.body: clothes: deep pine velvet riding gown with lined long sleeves, silver constellation embroidery, fitted bodice, and quilted wool underskirt, detachable sable-edged pelisse, star hairpin, cedar vow locket, leather gloves, and black fur-lined snow boots.

prompts.title: Rime Orchard Enchantress
prompts.body: clothes: plum wool-silk gown with lined sleeves, ruched branch appliqué, berry beadwork at the cuffs, and a layered quilted underskirt, removable fox-fur shoulder mantle, iced berry combs, apple amulet, knit gloves, and wine-red insulated boots.

prompts.title: White Stag Masquerade
prompts.body: clothes: ivory jacquard coatdress with lined sleeves, stag-track embroidery, fitted waist, and silver wool underskirt, detachable charcoal-fur capelet fastened by a crystal clasp, half-mask, antler tiara, pearl ear chains, velvet gloves, and fur-lined frost boots.

prompts.title: Boreal Swan Oracle
prompts.body: clothes: seafoam wool-silk column gown with lined wing sleeves, swan beadwork across the back, nipped waist, and quilted underskirt, removable feather-and-fur cape, divination disk, aquamarine tassels, cashmere gloves, and pale shearling-lined boots.

prompts.title: Winter Solstice Archduchess
prompts.body: clothes: black velvet court turtleneck gown with lined sleeves, gold sunburst embroidery, structured bodice, and layered wool underskirt, detachable sable-edged mantle with amber lining, obsidian crown, velvet gloves, and lacquered insulated shoes.

prompts.title: Birchfire Betrothal
prompts.body: clothes: cinnamon brocade ball gown with lined sleeves, birch-leaf gold embroidery, fitted waist, and quilted russet underskirt, removable hooded cream cloak with fox-fur edging, copper diadem, betrothal ring, fur muff, and shearling-lined button boots.

prompts.title: Frosted Mirror Sovereign
prompts.body:
Top & Bottom (Winter Gown): Cobalt velvet gown with a fitted bodice, high mirrored collar, long sleeves, and a full silver-blue skirt embroidered with frost-crystal beads.
Layer: Detachable midnight-blue fur-trimmed cloak with a soft silver lining, fastened with a sapphire clasp.
Footwear: Blue leather winter boots with a low heel and embroidered snowflake panels.
Accessories: Hail-crystal hair comb, sapphire girdle, and warm silver-thread gloves.

prompts.title: Glacial Snow Queen
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Sculpted silver-and-white stiffened silk-lace snowflake coronet headband worn pushed far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a dramatic, fan-pleated translucent silver silk-organza standing "ice-shard" collar edged in fluffy white swan-down that frames the back of her head and bare neck.
Top: Hourglass-boned glacier-blue silk-velvet fairytale bodice intricately embroidered with silver-and-white silk thread crystalline snowflakes across the bust and ribs, paired with sheer frost-white tulle bishop sleeves dusted with embroidered silver frost-ferns and gathered into deep glacier-blue velvet wrist cuffs.
Bottom: High-waisted glacier-blue silk-velvet overskirt cut into pointed icicle-shaped panels bordered in white swan-down, parting over a shimmering silver-white micro-pleated silk-satin underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer white silk stockings with silver snowflake embroidery and glacier-blue satin pointed fairytale court slippers.

prompts.title: Boreal Sky Court
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Padded midnight-blue velvet crescent headband embroidered with silver silk stars worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow iridescent teal satin ribbon tied around her neck.
Top: Sculpted midnight-navy silk-velvet sweetheart bodice embroidered with swirling ribbons of luminous emerald-green, violet, and rose-pink silk thread across the chest, draped at the shoulders with an ethereal, floor-length Northern Lights silk-chiffon capelet that shifts in a glowing ombré gradient from Boreal green to twilight magenta.
Bottom: High-waisted, liquid-draped silk-chiffon and organza court skirt layered in translucent waves of Boreal emerald, aquamarine, and violet over a midnight-blue satin base, cinched at the waist with a braided silver silk cord.
Legwear & Footwear: Sheer midnight-blue silk hose and iridescent teal-and-violet shot-silk court heels.

prompts.title: Whispering Pine Stag
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Braided spruce-green velvet and silver-cord Nordic woodland headband adorned with fabric white snowberries worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, with a plush pure-white arctic-fox fur mantle collar resting warmly around her shoulders and framing her bare throat.
Top: Fitted deep spruce-green heavy silk-velvet bodice embroidered in cream, pale-gold, and silver folkloric Nordic rosemaling scrolls and two leaping white stags across the bust, layered over a cream fine-wool chemise with billowy lantern sleeves embroidered with pine boughs.
Bottom: Deeply pleated spruce-green velvet court skirt parted at the center front to reveal a cream-and-silver floral damask underskirt bordered with white arctic-fox fur.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream cable-knit wool stockings and spruce-green suede lace-up fairytale court boots trimmed with white fur.

prompts.title: Scarlet Rowan Princess
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Regal, arched scarlet-red velvet Northern fairytale crown-headband (kokoshnik-inspired silhouette) richly embroidered with white silk snowflakes and crimson fabric rowan-berry clusters, worn tilted far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, with a narrow scarlet velvet ribbon around her neck.
Top: Fitted crimson-red silk-velvet sleeveless fairytale court vest-bodice laced up the front with white silk cord and embroidered with scarlet rowan berries and green winter-holly leaves, worn over a crisp snow-white heavy silk-satin blouse with voluminous puffed sleeves gathered at the wrists with red embroidered ribbon bands.
Bottom: High-waisted snow-white wool-satin pleated court skirt lavishly embroidered along the upper thighs with a wide folkloric border of crimson rowan berries and scarlet velvet ribbon trim.
Legwear & Footwear: White knitted silk stockings and crimson-red kidskin leather fairytale court boots.

prompts.title: Polar Star Pelisse
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Fluffy polar-white faux-fur winter halo headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck framed by the cloud-like fur lapels of her pelisse.
Top: Shimmering champagne-gold and ivory woven star-damask fitted fairytale bodice with a low square neckline, worn underneath an enchanting, open-front ivory diamond-quilted silk-duchesse court pelisse lavishly bordered down the front and around the wide bell sleeves with thick, cloud-soft polar-white fur.
Bottom: Flared ivory diamond-quilted silk pelisse skirt edged in polar-white fur, parting at the front to showcase the pleated champagne-gold star-damask kirtle skirt underneath.
Legwear & Footwear: Ivory cashmere-silk hose and polar-white fur-trimmed champagne satin court slippers.

prompts.title: Snowy Owl Valkyrie
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Sculpted white-and-barred-grey feather wing headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a high, cozy shoulder capelet of layered snowy-owl-patterned white and soft-grey plumage fastened at the throat with a braided silver silk cord.
Top: Form-fitting storm-grey sueded-velvet bodice contoured with silver-thread Nordic knotwork and overlapping feather-shaped velvet panels down the torso, worn over a pale ice-blue silk under-bodice with fitted sleeves slashed at the puffs to reveal white silk underneath.
Bottom: High-waisted pleated storm-grey velvet split court skirt bordered with silver knotwork embroidery, parting over a flowing ice-blue liquid silk-satin underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Pale-grey silk hose and storm-grey suede tall court boots laced with silver silk ribbon.

prompts.title: Evernight North Star
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Oversized, fairytale-draped twilight-sapphire velvet hood lined in plush cream curly-lambskin resting completely down behind her shoulders (leaving her head and forehead bare), paired with a narrow gold satin ribbon around her neck.
Top: Deep twilight-sapphire silk-velvet square-neck bodice embroidered in gleaming gold silk thread with a radiant North Star compass over her heart and leaping celestial reindeer along the waist, framed by the open front of her lambskin-lined sapphire velvet floor-length fairytale cloak and fitted gold-brocade sleeves.
Bottom: Full, cartridge-pleated twilight-sapphire velvet skirt scattered with embroidered gold stars and bordered at the waist with a braided gold silk girdle belt.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream wool-silk stockings and sapphire-blue velvet fur-lined court shoes.

prompts.title: Yuletide Hearth Princess
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Padded cranberry-red velvet and spotted white ermine fur fairytale pillbox coronet worn tilted far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow cranberry velvet ribbon bow around her neck.
Top: Warm spiced-cinnamon brown silk-velvet fitted court bodice embroidered in gold and cranberry silk thread with fairytale pinecones, winter wheat, and holly blossoms, bordered along the wide portrait neckline and elbow-length puffed sleeves with royal spotted white ermine fur over sheer cream silk undersleeves.
Bottom: Voluminous spiced-cinnamon velvet overskirt looped up at both hips with cranberry-red satin ribbon bows to display a rich cranberry-and-gold woven floral brocade underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Cream cable-knit silk-wool hose and cranberry velvet court heels trimmed with white ermine fur.

prompts.title: Frost in Bloom
prompts.body:
Top: Ice-blue satin bodice with a sweetheart neckline, silver snowflake embroidery spiraling from the waist, and sheer frosted tulle sleeves dusted with crystal beads.
Bottom: Full ballgown skirt in layered white and pale-blue organza, with hand-stitched silver frost vines climbing from the hem and a long translucent cape-train.
Accessories: Delicate crystal tiara shaped like frozen branches, snowdrop-shaped earrings, and a silver locket etched with a tiny winter rose.
Footwear: Silver-white satin slippers with crystal-beaded toes.

prompts.title: Winter Wolf Regent
prompts.body: clothes: ice-blue brocade greatcoat with a heavy white fur collar over a riveted mail hauberk, charcoal breeches strapped at the knee, wolf-head clasp, fur-lined gauntlets, studded war belt, tall shearling boots

prompts.title: Aurora Sledge Envoy
prompts.body: clothes: cobalt wool riding coat with a belted, fur-lined split skirt over silver quilted breeches, aurora embroidery sweeping diagonally across one shoulder, smoked snow goggles, sealed dispatch cylinder, leather gauntlets, and fur-lined reindeer-hide riding boots.
prompts.titleRu: Посланник Северного сияния в дорожном наряде

prompts.title: Icepine Forbidden Heir

prompts.title: Glacier Choir Prince
prompts.body: clothes: pearl-white silk doublet beneath an ivory fur-trimmed coat and ice-blue cape, sculpted shoulders and snow-crystal embroidery concentrating around the long cuffs, sapphire circlet, chime reliquary pendant, enamel cuff chains, embroidered sash, tapered trousers, and ivory court boots.

prompts.title: Moonbear Oath Knight
prompts.body: clothes: charcoal wool tunic under a blackened scale tabard and broad white-fur mantle, crescent runes woven along the pleated skirt panels and cuff closures, crescent helm circlet, bear-claw gorget, oath scroll case, moonstone buckle, and iron snow boots.

prompts.title: Rimeforge Heir
prompts.body: clothes: copper-blue wool brocade coat with interwoven frost scrolls, rust silk cuff facings, and copper-thread knotwork along the buttoned front over a charcoal wool tunic and straight trousers, narrow silver-buckled belt, shearling collar, lined leather gloves, and fur-lined winter boots

prompts.title: White Owl Envoy
prompts.body: clothes: ivory wool riding coat with an overlapping front, quilted lining, and pearl-grey fur cuffs over a dove damask waistcoat, linen shirt, and slate trousers, silver feather embroidery bordering the collar, engraved silver throat clasp, leather gloves, and insulated riding boots

prompts.title: Frostvine Ballad Heir
prompts.body: clothes: deep plum velvet tunic under a silver-threaded vine cloak, broad fur collar and frost-berry embroidery curling around the asymmetrical mantle, amethyst hair fork, crystal-harnessed harp, carved berry brooch, layered sash, slate trousers, and soft lace-up boots.

prompts.title: Hail Crown Betrothal
prompts.body: clothes: cobalt velvet doublet with silver braided closures and tiny crystal beads sewn into frost embroidery at the cuffs over an ivory wool shirt and charcoal trousers, midnight wool cloak with sable lining, sapphire circlet, white gloves, and fur-lined blue boots

prompts.title: Ravenfell Oathbearer
prompts.body: clothes: ink-black quilted tunic beneath a pewter wool surcoat and raven-feather mantle, silver feather embroidery running down the back panel and clawed cuff closures, obsidian hair clasp, sealed oath locket, beak gorget, belt plaques, and ash-grey fur boots.

prompts.title: Polar Night Marquess
prompts.body: clothes: black-blue velvet inner coat beneath a midnight cape with star-speckled lining, silver eclipse embroidery circling the sculpted shoulders and tapered sleeves, obsidian coronet, dark-glass astrolabe, chain-linked cuffs, sable gloves, fitted trousers, and mirror-polished winter boots.

prompts.title: Comet Cathedral Magus
prompts.body: clothes: slate wool cassock with a quilted lining, close sleeves, and midnight jacquard front borders embroidered with silver comet trails over a cream linen undershirt and black wool trousers, fur-lined hood fastened by an enamel clasp, leather gloves, and insulated boots

prompts.title: Silver Fir Masquerader
prompts.body: clothes: forest-green velvet cutaway coat with silver fir-needle embroidery along scalloped pocket flaps and a soft grey fur collar over an ivory damask waistcoat, linen shirt, and black wool trousers, silver filigree half-mask, dark leather gloves, and polished button boots

sections.name: Slavic Folklore & Forest Spirits
sections.description: Forest spirits and household rites in embroidered linen, woven wool, carved wood, birch bark, bast and amber.
sections.descriptionRu: Образы лесных духов и домашних обрядов: вышитый лён, тканая шерсть, резное дерево, береста, лыко и янтарь.

prompts.title: Birch Grove Hostess
prompts.body: clothes: undyed linen shift with gathered sleeves beneath a moss-green wool sarafan, red tablet-woven shoulder bands and birch-leaf embroidery at the hem, woven sash, carved birch offering spoon, rowan charm, amber earrings, and red leather ankle boots

prompts.title: Willow Mill Rusalka
prompts.body: clothes: water-blue linen blouse with full sleeves under a charcoal checked wool wrap skirt and reed-green apron, silver-thread wave embroidery around cuffs, flour sieve charm, copper spindle, glass bead necklace, and soft woven bast slippers

prompts.title: Kikimora Loom Listener
prompts.body: clothes: cream hemp chemise beneath a madder-red sleeveless overdress with side lacing, black geometric embroidery guarding neckline and hem, striped woven apron, linden distaff, bone spindle, tangled thread bundle, amber temple rings, and black leather lace-up shoes

prompts.title: Noonfield Sheaf Keeper
prompts.body: clothes: white linen shirt-dress with voluminous sleeves beneath a saffron pleated wool skirt and short crimson bodice, red sunwheel embroidery at cuffs, braided belt, woven straw visor, sheaf ribbon, wooden noon dial, poppy pouch, and red strapped leather shoes

prompts.title: Alder Bathhouse Hostess
prompts.body: clothes: smoke-grey linen chemise under a loose alder-brown wool robe crossed with a tablet-woven belt, steam-blue embroidery curling along wide cuffs, birch whisk bundle, carved water dipper, herb sachet, amber bead pins, and bark-soled leather slippers

prompts.title: Rowan Cradle Keeper
prompts.body: clothes: ivory flax blouse beneath a rust quilted waistcoat and indigo bell-shaped wool skirt, red protective embroidery circling collar and pockets, striped cradle cloth, rowan-wood rattle, beeswax candle case, braided key cord, amber brooch, and oxblood buckle shoes

prompts.title: Berries & Folktales
prompts.body:
Top: Cream linen blouse with red cross-stitch embroidery at the collar and cuffs, a fitted black velvet vest with tiny floral appliqués, and puffed sleeves gathered with red ribbon.
Bottom: Full red wool skirt with a wide embroidered hem of poppies and cornflowers, layered over a white ruffled petticoat, with a patterned apron tied in a bow.
Accessories: Floral wreath with long trailing ribbons, red coral bead necklace, and a small woven berry basket.
Footwear: Soft brown leather boots with red embroidered cuffs.

prompts.title: Mushroom Mischief
prompts.body:
Top: Moss-green linen bodice with cream stitched toadstool motifs, a lace-edged collar, and loose white sleeves with embroidered cuffs.
Bottom: Layered skirt in rust, cream, and olive wool with a scalloped hem, red-and-white polka-dot patches, and tiny wooden button accents.
Accessories: Crown of woven twigs with felt mushrooms, acorn-cap earrings, and a wooden bead necklace.
Footwear: Brown leather ankle boots with cream stitching and tiny felt mushroom charms.

prompts.title: Firebird Revelry
prompts.body:
Top: Scarlet and gold brocade bodice with a fitted waist, embroidered feather patterns, and sheer orange sleeves with gold-thread cuffs.
Bottom: Flowing tiered skirt in flame-red, amber, and gold silk, with embroidered plumes at the hem and a long feathered train.
Accessories: Gold kokoshnik headdress with tall ember-orange plumes, amber drop earrings, and a filigree feather pendant.
Footwear: Gold leather slippers with red embroidery and tiny feather charms.

prompts.title: Snow Maiden's Secret
prompts.body:
Top: White wool bodice with silver snowflake embroidery, a pale-blue fur-trimmed collar, and fitted sleeves with icy-blue cross-stitch cuffs.
Bottom: Full skirt in layered ivory and frost-blue wool, with embroidered pine branches along the hem and a trailing white velvet cape.
Accessories: Silver-and-pearl kokoshnik, crystal icicle earrings, and a fur muff with a tiny bell charm.
Footwear: White fur-lined boots with silver stitching and blue ribbon ties.

prompts.title: Sunflower Spell
prompts.body:
Top: Ivory embroidered blouse with golden sunflower cross-stitch, a green velvet corset vest with yellow ribbon lacing, and loose sleeves tied with ribbon at the elbows.
Bottom: Wide skirt in layered sunny yellow and green cotton, with embroidered sunflowers, wheat sprigs, and a patterned apron in cream and gold.
Accessories: Wreath of sunflowers and wheat with long ribbon tails, amber bead necklace, and small gold hoop earrings.
Footwear: Tan leather boots with yellow ribbon laces and floral embroidery.

prompts.title: Leshy Boundary Walker
prompts.body: clothes: moss-brown linen shirt beneath a long lichen-green wool svita with offset wooden toggles and straight charcoal trousers, oak-root embroidery circling one cuff, bark belt, birch-bark boundary map, and woven bast lapti; the embroidered roots subtly turn toward crossed forest borders

prompts.title: Hearth Domovoi Steward
prompts.body: clothes: oatmeal linen shirt under a cinnamon wool kaftan with braided closures and loose charcoal trousers, red hearth embroidery centered across the chest, woven sash, iron stove key, and soft leather postoly; the stitched coals warm faintly whenever the household fire begins fading

prompts.title: Millrace Vodyanoy
prompts.body: clothes: reed-grey hemp tunic beneath a dark-teal wool coat with side vents and braided cord fastenings, paired with waxed brown trousers, green wave embroidery across one shoulder, rope coil, and pitch-treated ankle boots; the embroidered waves bead with moisture before the millrace rises

prompts.title: Linden Hive Charmer
prompts.body: clothes: cream linen shirt beneath a fitted russet wool vest and wide ochre trousers, amber-and-black honeycomb embroidery covering one breast panel, folded apiary veil, birch-bark hive ledger, and brown leather field shoes; the stitched cells hum softly before a swarm leaves its hive

prompts.title: Ovinnik Barn Watcher
prompts.body: clothes: charcoal hemp shirt and loose brown trousers beneath an ochre belted linen oversmock, black zigzag embroidery crossing the structured yoke, grain scoop, rye pouch, bast gaiters, and hobnailed work boots; the raised stitches bristle like grain awns when hidden embers stir

prompts.title: Linden Spirit Carver
prompts.body: clothes: madder-red linen tunic and straight charcoal trousers beneath a short black wool jacket, cream spiral embroidery at the cuffs, striped linen carving apron, linden mask, belt-mounted gouge case, and brown leather turnshoes; the embroidered spirals follow touched wood grain

sections.name: Nile Courts & Arabian Nights

sections.description: Distinct Nile-inspired and Arabian Nights fantasy traditions joined by luminous ceremonial dress.
sections.descriptionRu: Фэнтезийные традиции долины Нила и арабских ночей, объединённые сияющими церемониальными нарядами.

prompts.title: Ivory Moon Goddess
prompts.body: clothes: ivory silk halter column gown with a sculpted gold bodice, pearl bead-net shoulders, and translucent split cape panels edged in moon embroidery, forehead chain, crescent collar, waist chains, articulated rings, ankle bells, and gilded sandals.

prompts.title: Golden Lotus Dreamer
prompts.body: clothes: champagne bandeau beneath a gold lotus bead-net overlay, high-slit cream skirt with translucent petal overskirt and coin droplets at the hem, jeweled veil pins, broad collar, navel chain, stacked cuffs, armlets, and pearl sandals.

prompts.title: Pearl Mirage Enchantress
prompts.body: clothes: pearl-white draped gown with a low gold-edged neckline, fitted waist, and wing-shaped gauze cape train embroidered at its edges, crystal forehead chain, lapis shoulder chains, hand chains, delicate girdle, and gold sandals.

prompts.title: Lapis Moonlit Palace
prompts.body:
Top: Lapis-blue silk cropped bodice with a soft square neckline, gold filigree edging, and jewel-shaped clasps at the center front.
Bottom: Flowing cream harem trousers with layered lapis drapes at the hips and embroidered gold star patterns along the cuffs.
Layer: Sheer lapis overskirt and veil panels, fastened at the shoulders and waist with delicate chains and small gold ornaments.
Footwear: Curled ivory slippers with gold stitching.
Accessories: Jeweled comb, body chain, faience collar, pearl armlets, and delicate hand chains.

prompts.title: Star-Sand Oracle
prompts.body:
Top: Moon-white silk wrap bodice with a shimmering gold-mesh overlay, draped split sleeves, and a gilded carnelian belt set with star-shaped sunstones.
Bottom: Full layered desert-sand and ivory chiffon skirt with gold star-bead embroidery near the hem and soft side panels that part over a luminous champagne-gold underskirt.
Layer: Floating gold-dusted silk veil attached at the shoulders and fastened with a filigree crescent clasp.
Footwear: Embroidered gold sandals with curled toes and delicate coin anklets.
Accessories: Celestial gold forehead chain, pearl-and-amber broad collar, gilded waist chains, and articulated finger rings.

prompts.title: Rosewater Moon Dancer
prompts.body: clothes: ivory caftan gown beneath a rose-gold cape, nipped bodice, side drapes, and gauze moon panels embroidered along its fluted cuffs, ruby veil pin, ear chains, shoulder jewelry, pearl girdle, and crimson curled slippers.

prompts.title: Turquoise Djinn Beloved
prompts.body: clothes: pearl-white silk halter gown beneath a turquoise gauze overrobe, fitted waist and slit skirt caught by gold chain drapes, opal forehead chain, crystal lamp talisman, shoulder chains, hand jewelry, coin sash, and moon-grey slippers.

prompts.title: Amethyst Starlight Dancer
prompts.body:
Top: Champagne silk fitted bodice with amethyst star filigree, a softly squared neckline, and sheer gold-dotted sleeves.
Bottom: Ivory harem trousers under a divided overskirt of pale lilac silk, layered with flowing amethyst and gold drapes.
Layer: Short translucent veil-cape with celestial embroidery and tassel edging.
Footwear: Soft velvet slippers with gold and amethyst beadwork.
Accessories: Astrolabe hair comb, crescent collar, finger chains, enamel girdle, and delicate tassel anklets.

prompts.title: Emerald Oasis Empress
prompts.body:
Top & Bottom (Court Gown): Flowing pale-sand silk gown with a fitted emerald bodice, long bell sleeves, and layered skirt panels embroidered with gold feather and palm motifs.
Layer: Translucent emerald shoulder veils and a long open-front gold-thread mantle that trails behind.
Headwear & Accessories: Jeweled emerald turban with a gold comb, pearl sash, armlet cuffs, and a delicate body chain.
Footwear: Gilt sandals with small emerald stones.

prompts.title: Lapis River Beloved
prompts.body: clothes: ivory draped sheath over a sheer lapis overskirt, open-waist corset, rippling gold pleat embroidery, and translucent waterfall panels falling from the hip, reed forehead chain, ankh collar, shell girdle, blue enamel bracelets, hand chain, and pearl sandals.

prompts.title: Jasmine Lantern Enchantress
prompts.body: clothes: cream silk caftan over emerald sirwal, shaped waist and embroidered sheer lantern sleeves with jasmine vines along their edges, pearl veil pins, brass lantern charm, scent chatelaine, gold coin girdle, stacked cuffs, and jade slippers.

prompts.title: Sunlit Veil Sovereign
prompts.body: clothes: ivory halter gown beneath a structured gold shoulder mantle, red sun beadwork radiating from the fitted waist into a split chiffon train, cobra forehead chain, carnelian collar, arm cuffs, hand chains, pearl anklets, and gilded sandals.

prompts.title: Mirage Chain Sorceress
prompts.body: clothes: champagne silk bandeau with an ivory split-skirt ensemble, gold geometric filigree across the fitted hip panels beneath a translucent sand veil, quartz comb, miniature carpet talisman, waist chains, articulated rings, shoulder drapes, and curled suede slippers.

prompts.title: Pearl Night Veil
prompts.body:
Top: Blackberry velvet fitted bodice with a curved neckline and silver star embroidery, beneath a sheer black robe with wide flowing sleeves.
Bottom: Full blackberry skirt with side drapes, pearl-speckled black chiffon overskirt, and silver constellation embroidery along the hem.
Layer: Long black veil attached at the shoulders, dotted with small pearls and lined in muted plum.
Footwear: Plum velvet slippers with silver embroidery.
Accessories: Crescent hair jewel, beaded ear cuffs, story-token pendant, and delicate hand chains.

prompts.title: Sun-Pharaoh Kalasiris
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Braided gold-and-lapis-blue silk fillet headband adorned with a fabric blue lotus blossom worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a wide, semi-circular Egyptian usekh broad collar crafted from stiffened linen richly embroidered with concentric bands of turquoise, lapis-blue, carnelian-red, and gold silk threads resting flat across her collarbones.
Top: Gossamer, finely sun-pleated snow-white royal sheer-linen kalasiris bodice featuring wide pleated straps that frame her bust and narrow waist, cinched directly beneath the chest with a knotted metallic-gold and turquoise woven silk sash whose long embroidered lappets hang down the center front.
Bottom: High-waisted, form-skimming sun-pleated white linen wrap skirt layered over a shimmering gold-tissue silk underskirt, contoured closely to her hips and thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and braided gold-leather pharaonic ankle-tie sandals.

prompts.title: Starlit Seraglio
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Twisted peacock-teal and gold silk-brocade turban-style headband worn pushed far back on the crown behind her bare forehead with a sheer sapphire chiffon veil trailing down her back, paired with a narrow gold silk-satin ribbon around her neck.
Top: Plunging sapphire-blue pleated silk-chiffon halter bralette with gold-thread arabesque embroidery, layered underneath a cropped, open-front peacock-teal silk-velvet bolero vest richly embroidered with gold-and-emerald peacock feathers and bordered with swinging gold silk-thread tassels along the hem, exposing her toned bare midriff.
Bottom: Low-slung, billowy sapphire-blue translucent silk-chiffon harem trousers layered over opaque teal satin shorts, gathered into a wide gold-and-teal brocade hip band accented with draped silk-cord swags across her hips and upper thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare ankles and peacock-teal velvet curled-toe babouche court slippers embroidered with gold thread.

prompts.title: Crimson Oasis Dancer
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Narrow ruby-red velvet and gold-braid dancer’s headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a matching ruby velvet choker band edged in tiny crimson silk tassels around her throat.
Top: Sculpted ruby-red and metallic-gold damask sweetheart halter bustier intricately embroidered with gold paisley motifs and trimmed along the underbust with a kinetic row of swinging crimson-and-gold silk-thread fringe over her bare midriff, paired with detached, billowing scarlet silk-organza dancer sleeves split down the outer arms and caught at the upper arms and wrists with gold brocade bands.
Bottom: Low-rise, asymmetrical scarlet silk-chiffon dancer’sskirt-and-harem-pant set featuring a diagonally draped gold-embroidered crimson velvet hip sash fringed with silk tassels and high side slits that reveal her upper thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare feet and lower legs wrapped in crisscrossing crimson-and-gold silk-satin ankle ribbons.

prompts.title: Saffron Isis Priestess
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Stiffened gold-brocade vulture-wing court diadem headband worn pushed far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow turquoise silk ribbon tied around her neck.
Top: Deep V-neck saffron-gold micro-pleated liquid silk bodice crisscrossed over her bust and cinched at the ribs with a black-and-gold embroidered falcon sash, attached at the shoulders and wrists to dramatic, fan-pleated translucent turquoise-and-gold silk-organza "Isis wings" that drape gracefully behind her arms.
Bottom: High-waisted, column-draped saffron-gold pleated silk skirt parted at the center front to reveal a turquoise-and-gold lotus-embroidered linen underskirt.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and gilded turquoise leather temple sandals.

prompts.title: Moonlit Amethyst Caftan
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Padded dusty-rose and amethyst silk-satin crescent headband worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, leaving her neck and collarbones completely bare.
Top: Fitted deep-plum silk-velvet strapless sweetheart bandeau bustier embroidered with blush-pink and silver silk pomegranate blossoms, worn underneath an airy, floor-length open-front caftan robe crafted from iridescent blush-pink and amethyst shot-silk chiffon with wide butterfly sleeves and silver-thread embroidery along the open lapels, framing her bare midriff.
Bottom: High-waisted, liquid-gloss amethyst silk-satin wrap skirt featuring a gathered fabric knot at the left hip and a high front slit over the thigh, bordered with silver silk-thread floral embroidery.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and dusty-rose satin open-toe boudoir mules embroidered with silver thread.

prompts.title: Celestial Djinn Binder
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Pointed midnight-indigo velvet and copper-gold brocade cap worn tilted far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, with the open keyhole neckline of her sheer chemise framing her bare throat.
Top: Translucent spiced-cinnamon silk-crêpe chemise with billowing lantern sleeves, worn underneath a tailored, short-sleeved midnight-indigo and metallic-copper celestial brocade Persian court coat (qaba) featuring a deep V-neckline, braided copper silk frog closures fastened solely at her narrow waist, and intricate gold-thread embroidery of Solomon’s seals and zodiac constellations.
Bottom: Flared, hip-skimming skirts of the indigo celestial brocade coat parting over fitted cinnamon-silk harem trousers and wrapped around the waist with a wide striped copper-and-indigo silk sash.
Legwear & Footwear: Cinnamon silk hose and midnight-indigo leather heeled court boots with curled toes.

prompts.title: Ptolemaic Nile Queen
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Woven metallic-gold and seafoam-turquoise silk royal diadem band worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead with two long silk ribbons trailing down her back, leaving her neck bare.
Top: Draped seafoam-turquoise and gold shimmer-silk bodice gathered into a traditional sculpted "Isis knot" directly between and beneath her breasts, paired with a regal, asymmetrical one-shoulder capelet of tawny leopard-spotted printed silk-velvet bordered with gold silk braid draped over her left shoulder.
Bottom: High-waisted, finely pleated seafoam-turquoise silk-linen court skirt wrapped closely around her hips and thighs, accented with a hanging central apron-sash embroidered in gold, lapis, and coral silk lotus motifs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and gold-embroidered turquoise kidskin royal sandals.

prompts.title: Persian Rose Courtesan
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Jaunty pistachio-mint silk-velvet pillbox cap embroidered with coral silk roses worn tilted far back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a narrow coral-pink satin ribbon tied around her neck.
Top: Delicate, translucent cream spun-silk gauze off-the-shoulder blouse with billowy poet sleeves tied at the elbows with mint silk ribbons, layered underneath a form-fitting, low-cut pistachio-mint and coral-pomegranate floral Persian silk-brocade waistcoat bodice fastened under the bust with tiny fabric-covered buttons and exposing a peek of her bare waist.
Bottom: High-waisted, voluminous pistachio-mint silk-chiffon harem pants pleated into a wide coral-and-gold brocade waistband that hugs her hips before flaring softly around the thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare ankles and coral-pink velvet embroidered court slippers.

prompts.title: Memphis Lotus Dancer
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Narrow woven gold-and-lapis silk headband adorned with three fabric blue lotus buds worn pushed back on the crown behind her bare forehead, paired with a matching lapis-blue silk collar band embroidered with gold petals around her neck.
Top: Crisscrossed halter wrap crop top crafted from stiffened, sun-pleated silk-organza that transitions in an ombré gradient from ivory at the halter neck to deep lapis-lazuli blue across the bust, embroidered with gold-thread lotus petals and leaving her toned midriff and shoulders bare.
Bottom: Low-slung, structured Egyptian hip-girdle woven from gold, turquoise, and lapis-blue silk tapestry threads sitting snugly on her hips over a sheer, finely pleated ivory-to-lapis ombré linen wrap skirt split open at both thighs.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and braided gold-and-lapis silk ankle-tie dancer sandals.

prompts.title: Desert Flame Empress
prompts.body:
Headwear & Neckwear: Sculpted obsidian-black velvet and gold-embroidered desert coronet headband worn pushed far back on the crown behind her bare forehead with a sheer black-and-gold star-dusted tulle veil flowing down behind her shoulders, paired with a black velvet neck band.
Top: Plunging flame-orange and tangerine ombré silk-satin halter bustier crisscrossed across the chest and ribs with an intricate obsidian-black velvet and gold-embroidered fabric harness trimmed with swinging black silk tassels, paired with sheer black silk-chiffon floating arm-drapes attached to embroidered wrist cuffs, leaving her midriff bare.
Bottom: High-waisted, layered flame-orange and obsidian-black translucent silk-chiffon palace trousers featuring wide side slits from the hip to mid-thigh, bordered with gold arabesque embroidery and held by a V-shaped black-and-gold brocade waistband.
Legwear & Footwear: Bare lower legs and obsidian-black suede ankle-strap court heels embroidered with gold flames.

prompts.title: Peacock Sky Vizier
prompts.body: clothes: aqua brocade court coat with a high winged collar over a pale-gold tunic, straight aqua trousers tucked into curled boots, peacock-plume epaulettes, jeweled armlets, embroidered sash, turquoise-set turban pin

prompts.title: Falcon Sun Pharaoh
prompts.body: clothes: ivory linen tunic with elbow sleeves, narrow shoulder pleats, a buttoned slit neckline and woven falcon geometry along side vents over straight sand trousers; dominant articulated gold-and-lapis collar, slim gold brow band and braided leather sandals

prompts.title: Obsidian Court Vizier
prompts.body: clothes: ivory linen shirt with a buttoned collar and gathered cuffs, copper silk sirwal and a hip-length black silk waistcoat with woven palmette medallions and braided button loops; narrow leather belt with a pierced gold buckle, carnelian signet ring and indoor slippers

prompts.title: Lotus River Prince
prompts.body: clothes: ivory linen shirt with a slit neck and straight trousers beneath a sleeveless turquoise silk overcoat, knee-length and open below its lotus-engraved chest clasp, with fine pleats and pink woven front borders; lapis pendant, gold signet ring and woven leather sandals

prompts.title: Scarab Tomb Archivist
prompts.body: clothes: sand-colored long V-neck linen robe with a bound front opening over a carnelian tunic and tapered cream trousers, black scarab geometry embroidered along the cuffs, gold brow circlet, rigid tomb-record case, and cross-strapped leather sandals

prompts.title: Sphinx Eclipse Priest
prompts.body: clothes: ankle-length ink linen robe with a deep split neckline, sheer smoke sleeves, and copper eclipse embroidery radiating from the structured torso, violet pleated trousers visible through side vents, plain sculpted brow crown, single amethyst collar, and black leather sandals

prompts.title: Reed Court Chamberlain
prompts.body: clothes: flax linen cross-front tunic with elbow sleeves, an inner tie, drawn-thread cuffs and muted gold reed embroidery along the overlapping neckline, belted over straight indigo silk trousers; dominant leather belt with a chased lapis-set buckle, engraved wrist cuff and brown sandals

prompts.title: Turquoise Pavilion Prince
prompts.body: clothes: pale-blue linen shirt with a buttoned neck and ivory sirwal beneath a turquoise silk-damask robe, open below three chest buttons, with wide elbow sleeves, woven arabesque medallions and silver-cord front borders; pierced silver belt, turquoise signet ring and ivory indoor slippers

prompts.title: Sapphire Court Sorcerer
prompts.body: clothes: cream slit-neck shirt and ivory sirwal beneath a lightweight sapphire silk caftan with braided loop closures, open below the waist, arabesque-embroidered wrist cuffs and bound front edges; ivory turban secured with a sapphire brooch, engraved brass talisman pendant and blue slippers

prompts.body: clothes: sand linen shirt with a buttoned neck and charcoal sirwal beneath a cropped indigo silk jacket with straight sleeves, brass buttons and crescent-woven cuff borders; small brass astrolabe suspended from a leather waist belt by a buckled loop, signet ring and slippers

prompts.title: Amber Desert Prince
prompts.body: clothes: rust linen slit-neck shirt and sand sirwal beneath a knee-length ochre silk qaba, overlapping fronts tied at the waist, copper geometric shoulder embroidery and narrow wrist sleeves; cream linen headcloth fastened with an amber brooch, embossed leather belt and suede travelling boots

prompts.title: Carnelian Palace Prince
prompts.body: clothes: cream linen slit-neck tunic and tapered ivory trousers beneath a rose linen robe with narrow pleated sleeves, knotted loop closures ending at the waist and lotus-woven front borders framing its open lower front; dominant carnelian pendant, matching signet ring and leather sandals

prompts.title: Indigo Caravan Lord
prompts.body: clothes: sand striped linen tunic with a buttoned neck and charcoal sirwal beneath a hooded indigo linen burnous, its open front secured by a pierced silver throat clasp, geometric embroidery edging the hood; embossed leather belt, moonstone signet ring and calf-high travelling boots

prompts.title: Pomegranate Court Sultan
prompts.body: clothes: black silk slit-neck shirt and ebony sirwal beneath a vermilion silk-brocade caftan with woven pomegranate medallions, narrow sleeves and gold-cord button loops closing the front to mid-thigh above a walking opening; dominant garnet-buckled leather belt, gold signet ring and embroidered indoor slippers

prompts.title: Nile Onyx Sorcerer
prompts.body: clothes: smoke-grey linen tunic with a buttoned neck and teal trousers beneath a sleeveless black gauze robe, open below a bronze chest clasp, with bound armholes and stepped lotus embroidery along its front borders; broad onyx-set bronze collar, matching ring and leather sandals
